[Single choice]

Reading 1: Questions 36–39 form a group.

Metabolism is extremely important. When oxygen is lacking, animals carry out anaerobic respiration, which not only accumulates lactic acid but also sharply reduces the energy produced. Evidently, when the oxygen supply is insufficient, the accumulation of lactic acid and the shortage of energy in the body are serious problems. Excess lactic acid is often considered the main cause of muscle fatigue, while a shortage of energy is very harmful to brain tissue; brain cells are very prone to die under such conditions, and animals in general cannot survive prolonged oxygen deficiency or anoxic conditions.

A few animals can live for quite a long time under oxygen-deficient conditions, such as turtles and the Nordic crucian carp; the latter can even live for several months in small ice-covered ponds in winter, showing that its metabolism has been suitably regulated and adapted. Research has found that the metabolism of the muscle and other organs of the Nordic crucian carp in a cold, oxygen-deficient environment is briefly as shown in Figure 1, and that during oxygen deficiency the blood flow perfusing the brain increases (Figure 2). The goldfish is also an animal that tolerates oxygen deficiency; it belongs to the same genus Carassius as the Nordic crucian carp, and when deprived of oxygen its metabolic products are the same as those of the Nordic crucian carp (Table 1). Analyze these figures and the table, and answer according to them.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2002-1-fig1.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 肝醣 → glycogen; 肌肉 → muscle; 葡萄糖 → glucose; 乳酸塩 → lactate; 丙酮酸塩 → pyruvate; 丙酮酸去氫酵素 → pyruvate dehydrogenase; 乙醛 → acetaldehyde; 酒精去氫酵素 → alcohol dehydrogenase; 酒精 → alcohol; 血液 → blood; 一般器官 → other organs; 鰓 → gills; 圖1. 北歐鯽新陳代謝示意圖 → Figure 1. Schematic diagram of the metabolism of the Nordic crucian carp

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2002-1-fig2.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 腦部血流量(%) → cerebral blood flow (%); 時間(分) → time (min); 無氧狀態 → anoxic state; 圖2. 腦血流量之時間變化 → Figure 2. Change of cerebral blood flow with time

Table 1  Contents of lactic acid and alcohol in the body of goldfish, which are close relatives of the Nordic crucian carp, after 12 hours of oxygen deprivation at 4°C (mM)

$$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{Tissue lactic acid} & \text{Tissue alcohol} & \text{Alcohol in water} \\ \hline \text{Control group} & 0.18 & 0 & 0 \\ \hline \text{Oxygen-deprived group} & 5.81 & 4.58 & 6.63 \\ \hline \end{array}$$

36. Judging from these figures and tables, the more of which substance there is in the body of the Nordic crucian carp, the better its ability to resist cold? (Single choice)

(A) alcohol

(B) glycogen

(C) lactic acid

(D) dehydrogenase

[單選題]

閱讀一

新陳代謝作用非常重要。缺氧時，動物進行無氧呼吸，不僅堆積乳酸，且產生的能量銳減。顯然動物在氧供應不足時，體內的乳酸堆積與能量不足是嚴重問題。乳酸過多常被認爲是引起肌肉疲勞的主因，而能量不足對腦組織非常不利，腦細胞在這種情況下極易死亡，一般動物無法在缺氧過久或無氧狀況下生存。

少數動物能在缺氧狀況下生活頗長的時間，如烏龜與北歐鯽，後者竟能在冬季冰凍小池塘裡生活數月之久，顯示它的新陳代謝，已有適當的調節與適應。研究發現北歐鯽在寒冷缺氧環境下，肌肉與其他器官的新陳代謝簡述如圖 1，缺氧期間，灌流腦部的血流量會增加（圖 2）。金魚也是耐缺氧的動物，與北歐鯽同屬 Carassius，缺氧時，其新陳代謝產物與北歐鯽相同（表 1）。試分析這些圖表，並依據這些圖表作答。

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2002-1-fig2.png

表 1 與北歐鯽相近的金魚在 4°C缺氧 12 小時後體內乳酸和酒精含量(mM)

$$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|}\hline & \text{組織的乳酸} & \text{組織的酒精} & \text{水中酒精} \\ \hline \text{對照組} & 0.18 & 0 & 0 \\ \hline \text{缺氧組} & 5.81 & 4.58 & 6.63 \\ \hline \end{array}$$

(A) 酒精

(B) 肝醣

(C) 乳酸

(D) 去氫酵素

Metabolism is extremely important. When oxygen is lacking, animals carry out anaerobic respiration, which not only accumulates lactic acid but also sharply reduces the energy produced. Reading 2: Questions 40–43 form a group.

In 1828, the botanist Brongniart established the genus Taxites on the basis of some foliage-bearing fossil plants collected from the Oligocene of France, and identified six species, of which T. langsdorfii attracted the most attention. In 1847 these fossils were first described by Endlicher, who at the same time named a tall coniferous tree of California, USA, the genus Sequoia. In 1855, Heer examined fossils unearthed in Switzerland, which included leaves and coexisting cones, and considered that all fossils identified as T. langsdorfii were remains of Sequoia. The original T. langsdorfii Brongniart was accordingly renamed Sequoia langsdorfii (Brongniart) Heer. Most of the many similar fossils discovered afterwards were S. langsdorfii.

In 1940, Miki discovered a fossil plant from Japan whose twigs resembled the bald cypress (Taxodium) and whose cones resembled the Sequoia, so he established a separate genus, Metasequoia, to show that it is a sister of Sequoia. In 1941, Miki found that Sequoia disticha Heer from the Arctic Circle was similar to the Japanese fossils, and accordingly corrected its scientific name to Metasequoia disticha (Heer) Miki. Thereafter, more data showed that Metasequoia disticha was widely distributed over the Eurasian continent from the late Cretaceous to the Miocene, and that until several million years ago it still existed in Japan and eastern Siberia.

In 1944, Wang Zhan discovered a 35-meter-tall large tree in Tibet, China, which the local residents called "shuishan" (dawn redwood) and revered as a sacred tree. Wang Zhan collected small twigs bearing needle leaves and cones and took them back for study, and they were determined by two professors, Hu Xiansu and Zheng Wanjun, to be Metasequoia disticha (Heer) Miki. This rare ancient tree became the focus of attention of the world botanical community - Metasequoia came alive again! In 1947, Merrill financed the collection of seeds and distributed them to botanical gardens around the world, so the tree spread far to foreign lands and appeared all over the world. In 1948, Chaney followed the Yangtze River across the mountains and reached the gorge where the dawn redwoods grow, and investigated the growth and distribution of the dawn redwood; he found about 8000-10000 trees in the mountain valley, about 5000 of which had a diameter of more than 20 cm, but there was no additional habitat nearby and the dawn redwood could not expand locally. However, since its seeds have been collected and cultivated elsewhere, dawn redwoods can now often be seen in parks and gardens around the world.

40. In the strata of which country was the fossil of Sequoia langsdorfii actually first found? (Single choice)

(A) Switzerland

(B) Japan

(C) the United States

(D) France

閱讀二

1828 年，植物學家布郎尼(Brongniart)以採自法國漸新世的一些著葉化石植物建立了擬紫衫屬(Taxites)，並鑑別六種，其中以 T. langsdorfii 最惹人注意。1847 年，這些化石初次被安黎胥(Endlicher)描述，同時他也將美國加州的一種高大針葉樹命名爲北美紅杉屬(Sequoia)。1855 年，黑爾(Heer)鑑定從瑞士出土的化石，它包括葉和並存的毬果，認爲所有被鑑定爲 T. langsdorfii 的化石，都是 Sequoia 的遺骸。原來的 T. langsdorfii Brongniart 遂被更名爲 Sequoia langsdorfii (Brongniart) Heer。此後更多的類似化石被發現，大多是 S. langsdorfii。

1940 年，三木(Miki)發現一種日本的化石植物，其枝條似落羽松(Taxodium)，毬果似北美紅杉，故另立一屬 Metasequoia，以示其爲北美紅杉之姊妹。1941 年，三木發現北極圈的 Sequoia disticha Heer 與日本之化石相似，遂修正其學名爲 Metasequoia disticha (Heer) Miki。此後，更多資料顯示，Metasequoia disticha 從白堊紀晚期到中新世廣布於歐亞大陸，直到數百萬年前它仍存在於日本和西伯利亞東部。

1944 年，王戰在中國西藏發現一株 35 公尺高的大樹，當地居民稱之爲“水杉”，奉如神木。王戰收集帶有針葉和毬果的小枝回去研究，並經胡先驌和鄭萬鈞兩位教授確定爲 Metasequoia disticha (Heer) Miki。此一稀世古樹竟爲全球植物學界矚目的焦點 - Metasequoia 活現了！1947 年，麥銳爾(Merrill)資助採集種子，分贈世界各地植物園，此樹因此遠播異域，出現在全球各地。1948 年，錢尼(Chaney)沿著長江越過山脈，到達水杉生長的峽谷，考察水杉生長和分布的情形，他發現山谷裡大約有 8000-10000 棵，其中約 5000 棵的直徑超過 20 公分，但附近已無額外的棲地，水杉不能在當地拓殖。不過，由於其種子被收集去外地培育，目前水杉在世界各地的公園與花園常看得到。

(A) 瑞士

(B) 日本

(C) 美國

(D) 法國

In 1940, Miki discovered a fossil plant from Japan whose twigs resembled the bald cypress (Taxodium) and whose cones resembled the Sequoia, so he established a separate genus, Metasequoia, to show that it is a sister of Sequoia. In 1941, Miki found that Sequoia disticha Heer from the Arctic Circle was similar to the Japanese fossils, and accordingly corrected its scientific name to Metasequoia disticha (Heer) Miki. Thereafter, more data showed that Metasequoia disticha was widely distributed over the Eurasian continent from the late Cretaceous to the Miocene, and that until several million years ago it still existed in Japan and eastern Siberia.

In 1944, Wang Zhan discovered a 35-meter-tall large tree in Tibet, China, which the local residents called "shuishan" (dawn redwood) and revered as a sacred tree. Wang Zhan collected small twigs bearing needle leaves and cones and took them back for study, and they were determined by two professors, Hu Xiansu and Zheng Wanjun, to be Metasequoia disticha (Heer) Miki. This rare ancient tree became the focus of attention of the world botanical community - Metasequoia came alive again! In 1947, Merrill financed the collection of seeds and distributed them to botanical gardens around the world, so the tree spread far to foreign lands and appeared all over the world. In 1948, Chaney followed the Yangtze River across the mountains and reached the gorge where the dawn redwoods grow, and investigated the growth and distribution of the dawn redwood; he found about 8000-10000 trees in the mountain valley, about 5000 of which had a diameter of more than 20 cm, but there was no additional habitat nearby and the dawn redwood could not expand locally. However, since its seeds have been collected and cultivated elsewhere, dawn redwoods can now often be seen in parks and gardens around the world.

43. Which of the following statements about the dawn redwood are correct? (Multiple choice)

(A) Wang Zhan was the first to discover living Metasequoia disticha

(B) Hu and Zheng were the first to name Metasequoia disticha

(C) Merrill caused the dawn redwood to sprout and revive again around the world

(D) The fossils of the dawn redwood were brought back to life through Chaney's careful care

(E) The dawn redwood was widely distributed over the Eurasian continent from the late Mesozoic to the middle Tertiary

Reading 3: Questions 44–47 form a group.

More than 100 years after Mendel published the results of his pea hybridization experiments, we have finally come to understand, at the level of molecules and genes, one of his typical experimental results: in a hybridization test for the seed-coat phenotype between a pea plant (P) with smooth seeds and a pea plant with wrinkled seeds, all of the F1 generation were of the smooth type, and the reason why the F2 generation showed smooth-type and wrinkled-type pea plants in a ratio of 2.96 : 1.

For quite a long time, biologists believed that the difference between smooth-type and wrinkled-type seeds was related to the hydrolysis of starch. Compared with seeds with heterozygous alleles (Ss) and seeds with double-dominant alleles (SS), seeds containing double-recessive alleles (ss) contain more sucrose during their development. As a result, the osmotic pressure of ss seeds is higher, and relatively more water enters the seed during its development. When the seed has completed development, the water decreases, but the seed coat does not shrink correspondingly, thus forming the wrinkled type. Further investigation found that the accumulation of sucrose in ss-type seeds is due to a defect in the gene of the enzyme that polymerizes monosaccharides into starch. This recessive allele (s) has 800 more base pairs than the dominant allele (S), causing the starch-branching enzyme to be inactivated, so that more sucrose accumulates in the seed.

44. Which of the following statements about Mendel's typical experiment is correct? (Single choice)

(A) The F1 genotype is SS

(B) F2 has two genotypes, SS and ss

(C) P must be certain to be a pure line

(D) The gene for the wrinkled type is dominant

孟德爾發表他的豌豆雜交實驗結果後 100 多年，我們終於在分子及基因的階層裏明白其典型的實驗結果之一：光滑種子與皺皮種子的豌豆株(P)進行種皮表型雜交試驗，其 F1 代全數爲光滑型，而 F2 代則光滑型與皺皮型的豌豆株爲 2.96：1 的緣由。

有一段相當長的時間，生物學家相信光滑型與皺皮型種子之差異與澱粉的水解有關。相較於異對偶(等位)基因(Ss)種子和雙顯性對偶基因(SS)種子，含雙隱性對偶基因(ss)的種子在其發育過程中含有較多的蔗糖。這麼一來，ss 種子的滲透壓較高，在其發育的過程中有相對多的水分進入種子之中。當種子發育完成，水分減少，但種皮卻不相對縮小，因而形成皺皮型。進一步探討發現，蔗糖累積於 ss 型種子之中，係因單醣聚合爲澱粉之酵素其基因產生缺陷所致。此隱性對偶基因(s)比顯性對偶基因(S)多出 800 個鹼基對，導致澱粉分支酶不活化，因而使較多的蔗糖累積在種子中。

(B) F2有兩個基因型SS及ss

(C) P必須確定是純品系

(D) 皺皮型基因爲顯性

problems.problem:
[Single choice]

Reading 4: Questions 48–51 form a group.

The force of life originates from energy! All activities of organisms, such as the swimming of bacteria and the reading of humans, require the input of some energy. The energy budget of organisms uses ATP as "currency"; in the cytoplasm each ATP represents 12 kcal glucose·mole$^{-1}$ (glucose·mole). In the biosphere of the early evolution of the Earth, heterotrophic organisms oxidized glucose by glycolysis to compounds such as pyruvate and could obtain 2 ATP. However, the energy contained in the chemical bonds of 1 mole of glucose is about 686 kcal. In present-day ecosystems, the species they contain are usually quite numerous and complex, and systems ecologists classify species according to the height of their trophic level in the ecosystem into producers, consumers, scavengers and decomposers. The organisms among the producers can take up their energy source directly from the inorganic environment, so they are called autotrophic; the energy of all the other trophic levels is taken from autotrophic organisms, and they are called heterotrophic. Suppose that in a grassland ecosystem, grass - herbivore - carnivore form a food chain of three trophic levels, the herbivorous consumers obtain energy only by glycolysis, and the carnivorous consumers, after preying on herbivores, also obtain energy only by glycolysis; then it is estimated that in the whole ecosystem only 0.12% of the energy originating from the producers can be used by the carnivores in their activities. The composition and biomass of the carnivores on this grassland would be far less abundant than on present-day African grasslands.

That the cells of organisms can carry out aerobic respiration, thereby producing further oxidative metabolism, was a great breakthrough in the course of evolution. The energy conversion rate of aerobic respiration reaches 52-63% within the cell, so that enough energy is retained in the ecosystem to build an adequate food chain and maintain the dynamic balance of the ecosystem. However, even though aerobic respiration raises the efficiency with which cells use energy resources (such as glucose), about two-thirds of the energy still escapes from the system when energy is transferred between the trophic levels of the ecosystem. This phenomenon directly affects the number of trophic levels in an ecosystem. Most ecosystems have only three trophic levels, and a few reach four. For example, on the African grassland the food chain grass - antelope - lion represents an ecosystem of three trophic levels, and it would be very difficult to intervene with humans to form a four-trophic-level system of grass - antelope - lion - human. This is because the biomass of lions is not enough for human use to achieve a constant and fairly large population level. If humans choose another way, intercepting grass (vegetables) or antelope midway to supplement energy and maintain a fair population level, then the so-called "four-trophic-level" system exists in name only.

48. How much energy is produced after one mole of glucose undergoes glycolysis? (Single choice)

(A) 12 kcal

(B) 24 kcal

(C) 343 kcal

(D) 686 kcal

[單選題]

閱讀四

生命力源於能！所有生物體之活動，如細菌之泳動、人之閱讀，均需若干能量之投入。生物體能量收支以 ATP 爲“通貨”；在細胞質中每一個 ATP 代表 12 kcal glucose·mole$^{-1}$（葡萄糖‧莫耳）。地球演化初期之生物圈，其異營生物體以糖解作用將葡萄糖氧化爲丙酮酸之類的化合物，可獲得 2 個 ATP。然而，1 莫耳的葡萄糖其化學鍵所蘊含的能量約爲 686 kcal。目前之生態系，其內含物種通常相當多而複雜，系統生態學者將物種依其在生態系中能階之高低加以歸類，而爲生產者、消費者、清除者和分解者。生產者中之生物體其能源可自無機環境中逕行擷取，故稱之爲自營性；其餘各能階之能量都取自自營生物，稱之爲異營性。假設在一草原生態系中，青草-草食性動物-肉食性動物形成三能階食物鏈，草食消費者只以糖解的方式獲得能量，而肉食消費者掠食草食動物後，亦僅以糖解爲能量之取得方式，則估計整個生態系只有 0.12%源於生產者的能量可供肉食動物運用於其活動中。此草原上肉食動物的組成及生物量將遠不及目前非洲草原上豐富。

生物體之細胞可行有氧呼吸，以產生進一步的氧化性新陳代謝，在演化過程中是一項大突破。有氧呼吸之能量轉換率在細胞內達到 52-63%，如此一來便有足夠的能量保留在生態系內，以建立充足的食物鏈，維持生態系的動態平衡。但是即使有氧呼吸提高了細胞運用能源物資（如葡萄糖）的利用效率，在生態系的能階間進行能之轉換，仍有約三分之二的量逸出系統。此一現象直接影響生態系中之能階層數。大部分的生態系只有三個能階分層，少數達到四層。例如在非洲的草原上，青草-羚羊-獅的食物鏈代表一個三能階的生態系，若將人介入以形成青草-羚羊-獅-人的四能階系統將非常不容易。這是因爲獅的生物量不足以提供人的利用，使人達成恆定而相當大的族群水準。若人另擇途徑，中途截取青草（菜）或羚羊以補足能量，維持一個相當的族群水準，那麼所謂的「四能階」系統便名存而實亡了。

48. 一莫耳的葡萄糖經糖解作用後產生多少能量？ (單選)

(A) 12 kcal

(B) 24 kcal

(C) 343 kcal

(D) 686 kcal

[Single choice]

Reading 4: Questions 48–51 form a group.

The force of life originates from energy! All activities of organisms, such as the swimming of bacteria and the reading of humans, require the input of some energy. The energy budget of organisms uses ATP as "currency"; in the cytoplasm each ATP represents 12 kcal glucose·mole$^{-1}$ (glucose·mole). In the biosphere of the early evolution of the Earth, heterotrophic organisms oxidized glucose by glycolysis to compounds such as pyruvate and could obtain 2 ATP. However, the energy contained in the chemical bonds of 1 mole of glucose is about 686 kcal. In present-day ecosystems, the species they contain are usually quite numerous and complex, and systems ecologists classify species according to the height of their trophic level in the ecosystem into producers, consumers, scavengers and decomposers. The organisms among the producers can take up their energy source directly from the inorganic environment, so they are called autotrophic; the energy of all the other trophic levels is taken from autotrophic organisms, and they are called heterotrophic. Suppose that in a grassland ecosystem, grass - herbivore - carnivore form a food chain of three trophic levels, the herbivorous consumers obtain energy only by glycolysis, and the carnivorous consumers, after preying on herbivores, also obtain energy only by glycolysis; then it is estimated that in the whole ecosystem only 0.12% of the energy originating from the producers can be used by the carnivores in their activities. The composition and biomass of the carnivores on this grassland would be far less abundant than on present-day African grasslands.

That the cells of organisms can carry out aerobic respiration, thereby producing further oxidative metabolism, was a great breakthrough in the course of evolution. The energy conversion rate of aerobic respiration reaches 52-63% within the cell, so that enough energy is retained in the ecosystem to build an adequate food chain and maintain the dynamic balance of the ecosystem. However, even though aerobic respiration raises the efficiency with which cells use energy resources (such as glucose), about two-thirds of the energy still escapes from the system when energy is transferred between the trophic levels of the ecosystem. This phenomenon directly affects the number of trophic levels in an ecosystem. Most ecosystems have only three trophic levels, and a few reach four. For example, on the African grassland the food chain grass - antelope - lion represents an ecosystem of three trophic levels, and it would be very difficult to intervene with humans to form a four-trophic-level system of grass - antelope - lion - human. This is because the biomass of lions is not enough for human use to achieve a constant and fairly large population level. If humans choose another way, intercepting grass (vegetables) or antelope midway to supplement energy and maintain a fair population level, then the so-called "four-trophic-level" system exists in name only.

(A) 63%

(B) 52%

(C) 3.5%

(D) 0.12%

52. A student observed the function of the kidneys of an anesthetized rat. During the experiment, he injected a large amount of hypotonic saline solution into the rat's vein, and at the same time collected urine from the bladder and blood from an artery. He sent the collected urine and blood to a research institution to have them analyzed, and obtained the results in the table below.

$$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline & \multicolumn{3}{c|}{\text{Urine}} & \multicolumn{2}{c|}{\text{Blood}} \\ \hline & \text{Volume} & \mathrm{Na^+} & \mathrm{K^+} & \mathrm{Na^+} & \mathrm{K^+} \\ \hline & \text{(mL/unit time)} & \multicolumn{2}{c|}{\text{(mEq/kg)}} & \multicolumn{2}{c|}{\text{(mEq/kg)}} \\ \hline \text{Before saline injection} & 25 & 15 & 35 & 155 & 45 \\ \hline \text{After saline injection} & 40 & 12 & 30 & 135 & 37 \\ \hline \end{array}$$

(2) On what basis do you judge?

(3) How has the antidiuretic hormone released from the posterior pituitary changed?

(4) What is the reason for this?

Taking Dolly the sheep as an example, the standard procedure for cloning an animal is mainly as follows: an egg cell is obtained from the egg donor (a black-faced ewe) and its nucleus is removed; a somatic cell (a mammary gland cell) is then obtained from the animal to be cloned (a white-faced ewe); using microinjection and electric shock, the egg cell is made to receive the somatic cell nucleus and divides to form a blastocyst, which can then be implanted into the body of a black-faced surrogate ewe. Reading 1: Questions 51–53 form a group.

Cuckoos choose other birds as hosts in order to carry out their special "nest parasitism" behavior. That is, just before laying, a cuckoo takes advantage of the host's absence, flies to the host's nest and lays one egg there, so that the host incubates and raises its offspring on its behalf. Once a young cuckoo hatches, even before its eyes have opened, it uses its back to heave any round objects it touches, or the eggs laid by the foster mother, out of the nest, so that the young cuckoo can monopolize the foster mother's care. Different strains of cuckoo look for different hosts; this phenomenon is called host specificity. Interestingly, the eggs laid by cuckoos each have their own characteristics and are often similar to those laid by the host, so that the host cannot tell real from fake and does not remove them. Huntington's disease (HD) is a dominant hereditary disease caused by a mutation of the normal Huntington gene. A person carrying a pair of mutant genes dies at birth, so patients are all heterozygous; the disease usually appears in the prime of life, in the 30s to 40s, and the patient dies 15 to 20 years after onset.

The symptoms of HD are caused by the degeneration of neurons in the striatum of the brain. Normally, the neurons there have an inhibitory effect on the excitatory signals sent by the motor cortex of the cerebrum, which controls body movements; if these cells die, the motor cortex becomes overexcited, causing the patient to make involuntary movements.

The normal Huntington gene of a healthy person contains a stretch of nucleotide sequence consisting of repeated occurrences of CAG, with the number of repeats between 9 and 35; in the Huntington gene of HD patients the number of CAG repeats is increased, usually 40 to 60, and in some cases even as many as 250.

The amino acid corresponding to the genetic code CAG is "glutamine". The normal Huntington protein protects the neurons of the brain. The mutant Huntington protein, because it has an overly long "polyglutamine" segment, causes the death of nerve cells and thereby causes the disease. Scientists have currently proposed two disease hypotheses, the "loss-of-function hypothesis" and the "gain-of-function hypothesis". The loss-of-function hypothesis holds that the overly long polyglutamine segment may cause the Huntington protein to lose its protective function; the gain-of-function hypothesis holds that the mutated Huntington protein is sticky and easily forms aggregates toxic to brain cells with normal Huntington protein or other proteins.

Answer the following questions based on the passage above:

杭丁頓氏症(Huntington’s disease; HD)是一種顯性遺傳疾病，起因於正常的杭丁頓基因發生突變。帶有一對突變基因者一出生便會死亡，因此患者都是異合子型，且通常在30∼40 幾歲的盛年發病，並於發病後15∼20 年去世。

HD 的症狀是由位於腦部紋狀體的神經元退化所造成。正常情況下，該處的神經元對掌管身體動作的大腦運動皮質所發出的興奮性訊號，具有抑制的作用，如果這些細胞死亡，運動皮質就會變得過度興奮，使患者產生不由自主的動作。

正常人的杭丁頓基因中含有由CAG 連續重複出現的一段核苷酸序列，重複次數在9∼35 次之間；HD 患者的杭丁頓基因中的CAG 重複次數會增加，通常為40∼60 次，某些案例甚至達250 次之多。

CAG 這個遺傳密碼相對應的胺基酸是「麩醯胺酸」。正常的杭丁頓蛋白質對大腦的神經元有保護作用。至於突變的杭丁頓蛋白質，因具有一段過長的「多麩醯胺酸」區段，結果造成神經細胞的死亡，進而引起疾病。目前科學家提出兩種疾病假說，分別是「喪失功能假說」及「獲得功能假說」。喪失功能假說認為過長的多麩醯胺酸區段可能會讓杭丁頓蛋白質失去保護功能；獲得功能假說則認為突變後的杭丁頓蛋白質具有黏性，易與正常的杭丁頓蛋白質或其他蛋白質形成對腦細胞有毒性的聚合物。

Zoologists originally thought that viviparity in reptiles and in mammals is not the same, because mammals have a placenta that connects the embryo to the mother and supplies it with nutrients, whereas the embryos of reptiles have no special structure connecting them to the mother and all the nutrients the embryo needs come from the yolk; reptilian viviparity was therefore called ovoviviparity, to distinguish it from mammalian viviparity. Later, however, zoologists found that the path from ovoviviparity to viviparity is in fact a continuous evolutionary process. The initial change was only to lengthen the time the fertilized egg stays in the mother's body; next it evolved so that the embryo develops using the yolk and leaves the mother's body only when about to hatch; after that, in some species the yolk decreased so much that the embryo has to obtain nutrients from the mother in order to develop into a young animal; later still, some species even evolved a placenta-like structure. Reading 1: Questions 34–35 form a group.

Aqueous solutions containing ions make up two-thirds of the weight of the human body, so to understand the mechanisms of life it is necessary first to understand how water molecules and ions move in and out of cell membranes. In 1988, Agre discovered many special membrane proteins on the cell membrane of red blood cells. These membrane proteins are embedded in the cell membrane and form channels that control the entry and exit of water molecules into and out of cells, and they are responsible for regulating the absorption and release of water by human tissues. His results also showed that hydrogen ions not only cannot pass through the water channels but also reduce the efficiency with which water molecules pass through them.

In 1996, MacKinnon began X-ray crystallographic studies of the potassium channel protein of the cell membrane. In 1998 he published important papers on the spatial structure of the potassium channel and its ion transport mechanism. His results showed that the potassium channel on the cell membrane allows only potassium ions to pass, whereas other ions such as sodium or calcium cannot pass, and the reason is related to the structure of the potassium channel protein.

Studying the characteristics of ion channels will make great contributions to the prevention and treatment of human diseases. For example, after a stroke, the glutamate NMDA-type receptors on the membranes of nerve cells are over-activated, so that large amounts of sodium and calcium ions enter the nerve cells and, by positive feedback, trigger the entry of even more calcium ions, which results in a series of chemical changes and the death of large numbers of nerve cells. If a new drug can be developed to prevent excess calcium ions from entering cells, it will help in treating stroke patients.

Based on the above text, answer Questions 34–35.

(B) Hydrogen ions also move in and out of cells through water channels

(C) Water molecules can freely pass through channels formed by cell membrane proteins

(D) The earliest research on cell water channels used nerve cells as material

(E) Compared with water molecules in an acidic solution, water molecules in a neutral solution enter cells more easily

閱讀一

在人體中，含離子的水溶液佔人體重量的三分之二，故要瞭解生命的機制，必須先了解水分子與離子是如何進出細胞膜。阿格雷於1988 年在紅血球的細胞膜上發現很多特別的膜蛋白，這些膜蛋白鑲嵌在細胞膜中，形成管制水分子進出細胞的通道，負責調節人體組織吸收和釋放水分。他的研究結果也顯示，氫離子不僅無法通過水通道，還會降低水分子通過水通道的效率。

1996 年，麥金農開始對細胞膜的鉀離子通道蛋白，進行X 光晶體光譜學的研究。1998 年，他發表有關鉀離子通道之空間結構及其離子運輸機制的重要論文。他的研究結果顯示，細胞膜上的鉀離子通道只容許鉀離子通過，而其他如鈉或鈣離子，則無法通過，究其原因是與鉀離子通道蛋白的結構有關。

研究離子通道的特性，對於預防及治療人類疾病將有極大的貢獻，例如發生腦中風後，神經細胞膜上的麩胺酸NMDA 型受器會被過度活化，使得鈉離子及鈣離子大量進入神經細胞，並以正回饋的方式引發更多鈣離子的進入，結果導致一連串化學變化，使得神經細胞大量死亡。若能研發出新藥物以阻止過多鈣離子進入細胞內，將有助於腦中風病患的治療。

根據上文，回答第34-35 題。

(E)相較於酸性溶液內的水分子，中性溶液內的水分子比較容易進入細胞

Reading 2: Questions 36–38 form a group.

Influenza viruses are divided into types A, B and C, of which influenza A virus has the widest host range and can infect many animals such as pigs, whales and birds; the avian influenza virus that everyone knows is an influenza A virus that infects birds. The surface of influenza A virus has two kinds of spike proteins, hemagglutinin and neuraminidase. The former allows the virus to enter cells and is therefore also the key factor determining the host specificity of the virus; the latter helps the progeny viruses to break out of the cell after the virus has finished multiplying inside it. According to the structures of these spike proteins, influenza A viruses can be further divided into many subtypes: hemagglutinin (represented by H) has 15 subtypes and neuraminidase (represented by N) has 9 subtypes. The "H5N1" virus that caused the avian influenza epidemic in Asia at the end of 2003 and the cases of human infection is an influenza A virus with the fifth subtype of hemagglutinin and the first subtype of neuraminidase.

In the past, the medical community believed that the toxicity of the avian influenza virus itself was the cause of human deaths, but new research has found that the over-reaction of the human immune system to the virus is the key. When the H5N1 avian influenza virus infects humans, it makes the human immune system over-react, so that it instead attacks normal cells in the body, leading to dysfunction of multiple organs, and in severe cases causing heart failure and even death. Scientists have now successfully developed a vaccine against the H5N1 avian influenza virus; this vaccine is suitable for both poultry and humans, bringing new hope for the prevention of avian influenza. However, experts say that avian influenza viruses keep mutating and may at any time produce new virus strains, posing a serious threat to the health and lives of humans worldwide.

Influenza viruses are divided into types A, B and C, of which influenza A virus has the widest host range and can infect many animals such as pigs, whales and birds; the avian influenza virus that everyone knows is an influenza A virus that infects birds. The surface of influenza A virus has two kinds of spike proteins, hemagglutinin and neuraminidase. The former allows the virus to enter cells and is therefore also the key factor determining the host specificity of the virus; the latter helps the progeny viruses to break out of the cell after the virus has finished multiplying inside it. According to the structures of these spike proteins, influenza A viruses can be further divided into many subtypes: hemagglutinin (represented by H) has 15 subtypes and neuraminidase (represented by N) has 9 subtypes. The "H5N1" virus that caused the avian influenza epidemic in Asia at the end of 2003 and the cases of human infection is an influenza A virus with the fifth subtype of hemagglutinin and the first subtype of neuraminidase.

In the past, the medical community believed that the toxicity of the avian influenza virus itself was the cause of human deaths, but new research has found that the over-reaction of the human immune system to the virus is the key. When the H5N1 avian influenza virus infects humans, it makes the human immune system over-react, so that it instead attacks normal cells in the body, leading to dysfunction of multiple organs, and in severe cases causing heart failure and even death. Scientists have now successfully developed a vaccine against the H5N1 avian influenza virus; this vaccine is suitable for both poultry and humans, bringing new hope for the prevention of avian influenza. However, experts say that avian influenza viruses keep mutating and may at any time produce new virus strains, posing a serious threat to the health and lives of humans worldwide.

Reading 3: Questions 39–41 form a group.

Reproduction-related behaviors of rodents, such as courtship behavior in males, the estrous cycle in females, mating behavior and pair bonding, are mainly regulated by the nervous and endocrine systems. The estrous cycle of female mice is mainly related to hormones secreted by the gonads; female mice whose ovaries have been removed do not show an estrous cycle, and the mating behavior of male mice is mainly regulated by testosterone. Recent studies using voles have shown that, besides the reproductive hormones produced by the gonads, antidiuretic hormone (ADH) and oxytocin released from the posterior pituitary also affect reproduction-related behavior. Voles are monogamous animals. For male voles, pair bonding is mainly influenced by ADH: after a male first mates with a female, the concentration of ADH in his brain rises sharply and induces pair-bonding behavior, and once pair bonding has been completed the male no longer mates with other females. If a male is pretreated with a drug that blocks the action of ADH, he can still mate with a female but does not form a pair bond with that female after mating. A similar situation in females is governed by oxytocin rather than ADH, but the detailed mechanism of action remains to be investigated further.

Based on the above text, answer Questions 39–41.

(A) It is unrelated to hormones released from the posterior pituitary

(B) The mating behavior of male mice is regulated by testosterone

(C) The mating behavior of male mice is not mainly controlled by oxytocin

(D) The estrous cycle of female mice is regulated by oxytocin

(E) The pair-bonding behavior of male mice is influenced by ADH

閱讀三

嚙齒類動物的生殖相關行為，如雄性的求偶行為、雌性動情週期的產生、交配行為及配對行為等，主要是受到神經及內分泌系統的調節。雌鼠的動情週期主要與性腺所分泌的激素有關，卵巢摘除後的雌鼠，不會出現動情週期；雄鼠的交配行為則主要受到睪固酮的調節。近期利用田鼠所進行的研究結果顯示，除了由性腺所製造的生殖激素外，腦垂腺後葉所釋放的抗利尿激素（簡稱為ADH）及催產素也會影響生殖相關行為。田鼠為一夫一妻制的生物，對雄鼠而言，其配對作用的產生，主要受到ADH 的影響，雄鼠與雌鼠發生初次交配行為後，雄鼠腦中ADH 之濃度會急速升高，誘發配對行為的產生，配對行為完成後，雄鼠即不再與其他雌鼠交配。若以可阻斷ADH 作用的藥物預先處理雄鼠，則雄鼠雖仍能與雌鼠交配，但交配後卻不會與該雌鼠發生配對行為，相似的情形在雌鼠身上則由催產素而非ADH 負責，但其詳細的作用機制，仍有待進一步探討。

Reading 1: Questions 34–36 form a group.

Biotechnology has provided many breakthroughs in crop improvement, and the one with the most extensive and far-reaching influence is the application of genetic transformation technology in agriculture. Scientists use the special mechanism by which Agrobacterium (Agrobacterium tumefaciens) infects plants and inserts its DNA into the plant genome to transfer a selected DNA into the genome of a plant, and the transformed plant genes can synthesize proteins that the plant would not originally produce. Because Agrobacterium can infect most dicotyledonous plants in nature, and the experimental procedure is quite simple, it has in recent years been widely used for the genetic transformation of plants. At present, the genes transferred into crops are mostly genes related to resistance to insects, resistance to pathogens, and resistance to herbicides. For example, a plant carrying an insect-resistance transgene produces an insecticidal protein by itself, without the need to spray insecticides separately. In this way, less pesticide can be used in growing crops, and in the future drought-tolerance genes may even be transferred into crops grown in originally water-scarce regions, to solve food problems in various places.

The first genetically modified crop (GM crop) to be formally put on the market was the FLAVR SAVR™ tomato produced by the Calgene company in 1995. It used genetic transformation technology to lower the activity of an enzyme that controls fruit softening, so as to delay fruit softening and make harvesting easier when planted over large areas. In recent years, the global commercial production area of GM crops has exceeded 52 million hectares, accounting for nearly one tenth of the world's arable land. More than 16 countries now have commercial production, of which the United States (68%) and Argentina (22%) are the largest GM crop producers. The commercially produced GM crops comprise 16 kinds of plants, concentrated mainly in soybean, maize, cotton and rapeseed; among them, soybean has the highest GM planting proportion, accounting for nearly half of all soybean production in the world. Because GM crops have superior genetic characteristics and the advantage of needing no special care after planting, more and more developing countries, such as South Africa and Mexico, have successively begun to plant these transgenic crops in order to reduce planting costs. However, for developing countries it is not easy to develop GM crops on their own, so most GM crops will inevitably have to be purchased from countries able to develop GM crops. In this way, the dependence of these developing countries on the countries that develop GM crops also increases, which may cause subsequent international social problems. On the other hand, although biotechnology provides new opportunities for variety improvement, many people also question whether these transgenic plants may bring unpredictable impacts on the natural environment. Genes put in by humans may flow into natural plant populations and cause major ecological effects. Therefore, to apply this technology, complete field trials must be carried out before formal mass production in order to understand the possible environmental and ecological impacts, and strict legislation is needed to protect the rights and interests of the producing companies, farmers and consumers.

閱讀一

生物科技提供了作物改良的許多突破性的進展，其中最具有廣泛而深遠影響的，就是基因轉殖技術在農業上的應用。科學家們利用農桿菌（Agrobacterium tumefaciens）感染植物並將其DNA插入植物基因體的特殊機制，可將所選定的DNA轉殖到植物的基因體中，被轉殖的植物基因可以合成原本自己不會產生的蛋白質。由於農桿菌在自然界可以感染大部分的雙子葉植物，且實驗操作相當簡易，因此近年來被廣泛地應用在植物的基因轉殖上。目前被轉殖作物的基因，大多是一些有關抗蟲、抗病菌、抗殺草劑的基因。比方說，一個具有抗蟲轉殖基因的植物，它會自行產生殺蟲蛋白質，而不需要另外噴灑殺蟲劑。如此一來，種植作物就可以少用農藥，將來甚至也可以轉殖耐旱的基因到原本缺水地區栽種的作物中，以解決各地的糧食問題。

第一個正式上市的基因轉殖作物（GM作物）是1995年Calgene公司所生產的FLAVR SAVR™蕃茄，其乃利用基因轉殖技術，將控制果實軟化的酵素活性降低，以延遲果實的軟化，方便大面積種植時的採收。近幾年來，全球商業化GM作物的生產面積已經超過了五千兩百萬公頃，幾乎佔了全球可耕地面積的十分之一。目前有商業生產的國家已超過16國，其中以美國（68%）和阿根廷（22%）為最大的GM作物生產國。而商業生產的GM作物共有16種植物，主要集中在大豆、玉米、棉花和油菜；其中大豆的GM種植比率最高，佔了全球所有大豆產量將近一半。由於GM作物有著較優良的遺傳特性，以及種植後不需要特別照顧的優點，故愈來愈多開發中的國家如南非、墨西哥等，相繼開始種植這些基因轉殖作物，以減低種植成本。然而對於開發中國家而言，自行開發GM作物並不容易，因此，大部分的GM作物勢必要向有能力開發GM作物的國家購買。如此一來，這些開發中國家對於開發GM作物國家的依賴程度也因此提高，而可能會造成後續的國際社會問題。另一方面，儘管生物科技提供了品種改良的新契機，但是也有許多人質疑這些基因轉殖植物可能會對自然環境帶來難以預料的衝擊。由人類所放入的基因可能會流入自然的植物族群中，造成生態上的重大影響。因此，要應用這種技術必須在正式大量生產前進行完整的田間試驗，以瞭解可能的環境生態衝擊，並且嚴謹的立法以保障生產公司、農民以及消費者的權益。

Because Agrobacterium can infect most dicotyledonous plants in nature, and the experimental procedure is quite simple, it has in recent years been widely used for the genetic transformation of plants. At present, the genes transferred into crops are mostly genes related to resistance to insects, resistance to pathogens, and resistance to herbicides. For example, a plant carrying an insect-resistance transgene produces an insecticidal protein by itself, without the need to spray insecticides separately. In this way, less pesticide can be used in growing crops, and in the future drought-tolerance genes may even be transferred into crops grown in originally water-scarce regions, to solve food problems in various places.

The first genetically modified crop (GM crop) to be formally put on the market was the FLAVR SAVR™ tomato produced by the Calgene company in 1995. It used genetic transformation technology to lower the activity of an enzyme that controls fruit softening, so as to delay fruit softening and make harvesting easier when planted over large areas. More than 16 countries now have commercial production, of which the United States (68%) and Argentina (22%) are the largest GM crop producers. The commercially produced GM crops comprise 16 kinds of plants, concentrated mainly in soybean, maize, cotton and rapeseed; among them, soybean has the highest GM planting proportion, accounting for nearly half of all soybean production in the world. Because GM crops have superior genetic characteristics and the advantage of needing no special care after planting, more and more developing countries, such as South Africa and Mexico, have successively begun to plant these transgenic crops in order to reduce planting costs. In this way, the dependence of these developing countries on the countries that develop GM crops also increases, which may cause subsequent international social problems. On the other hand, although biotechnology provides new opportunities for variety improvement, many people also question whether these transgenic plants may bring unpredictable impacts on the natural environment. Genes put in by humans may flow into natural plant populations and cause major ecological effects. 第一個正式上市的基因轉殖作物（GM作物）是1995年Calgene公司所生產的FLAVR SAVR™蕃茄，其乃利用基因轉殖技術，將控制果實軟化的酵素活性降低，以延遲果實的軟化，方便大面積種植時的採收。近幾年來，全球商業化GM作物的生產面積已經超過了五千兩百萬公頃，幾乎佔了全球可耕地面積的十分之一。目前有商業生產的國家已超過16國，其中以美國（68%）和阿根廷（22%）為最大的GM作物生產國。而商業生產的GM作物共有16種植物，主要集中在大豆、玉米、棉花和油菜；其中大豆的GM種植比率最高，佔了全球所有大豆產量將近一半。由於GM作物有著較優良的遺傳特性，以及種植後不需要特別照顧的優點，故愈來愈多開發中的國家如南非、墨西哥等，相繼開始種植這些基因轉殖作物，以減低種植成本。然而對於開發中國家而言，自行開發GM作物並不容易，因此，大部分的GM作物勢必要向有能力開發GM作物的國家購買。如此一來，這些開發中國家對於開發GM作物國家的依賴程度也因此提高，而可能會造成後續的國際社會問題。另一方面，儘管生物科技提供了品種改良的新契機，但是也有許多人質疑這些基因轉殖植物可能會對自然環境帶來難以預料的衝擊。由人類所放入的基因可能會流入自然的植物族群中，造成生態上的重大影響。因此，要應用這種技術必須在正式大量生產前進行完整的田間試驗，以瞭解可能的環境生態衝擊，並且嚴謹的立法以保障生產公司、農民以及消費者的權益。

Reading 2: Questions 37–39 form a group.

Programmed cell death (apoptosis), also called cell suicide, is an important defense mechanism against viral infection. Viruses are obligate intracellular parasites. Once a virus invades a cell, it immediately takes over the cell's biochemical factory to synthesize the substances it needs and replicates large numbers of progeny viruses. Scientists have found that a cell infected by a virus will, before the virus multiplies in large numbers, activate a suicide mechanism and end its life early, so as to limit the multiplication of the virus.

Programmed cell death can be achieved through an extrinsic response pathway or an intrinsic response pathway. In the intrinsic pathway, sensor molecules in the cell (such as the p53 protein) transmit a death signal to the mitochondria, which finally not only destroys the mitochondria but also causes the cell to die; in the extrinsic pathway, a death-signal receptor on the cell membrane is activated by a death-signal molecule from outside the cell (such as the TNF protein) and likewise starts the cell suicide response, but this response does not go through the mitochondria and instead directly activates enzymes in the cytoplasm to dismantle the cell. The death-signal molecules of the extrinsic pathway come from many sources; for example, when our natural killer cells detect traces of a virus, they release TNF to cause the virus-infected cell to commit suicide. Whether through the extrinsic or the intrinsic pathway, in the end the cell produces the same proteases and nucleases to break down the structure and DNA of the cell.

Because the cell dies early, the virus cannot complete its replication. In order to survive, viruses inevitably contest with the cell for control of the cell-death mechanism. Therefore programmed cell death exerts a selective pressure on viruses. Pathogenic viruses can usually prevent cell suicide, and each virus has its own unique strategy. By studying the strategies by which viruses inhibit cell suicide, we can further understand the complex response pathways of programmed cell death.

(B) It can kill invading viruses

(C) It is a strategy for viral multiplication

(D) Highly pathogenic viruses easily cause cells to undergo programmed cell death

(E) It has a natural-selection effect on viruses

閱讀二

細胞計劃性死亡(Apoptosis)，又稱之為細胞自殺作用，是我們對抗病毒感染的重要防禦機制。病毒是絕對細胞內寄生體。病毒一旦侵入細胞，便立刻主導細胞的生化工廠合成本身所需的物質，並複製出大量的子病毒。科學家發現被病毒感染的細胞會在病毒大量增殖前，啟動自殺機制提早結束生命以限制病毒增殖。

細胞計畫性死亡可藉外生反應路徑或者是內生反應路徑達成。在內生路徑中，細胞內的感應分子(如p53蛋白質)會將死亡訊號傳遞至粒線體，最後不僅破壞粒線體也使細胞死亡；而在外生路徑中，細胞膜上的死亡訊號受體被來自細胞外的死亡訊號分子(如TNF蛋白質)活化後，也會啟動細胞自殺反應，不過本反應不經粒線體，而是直接活化細胞質中的酵素以瓦解細胞。外生路徑中的死亡訊號分子的來源有多種，例如當我們的自然殺手細胞發現病毒蹤跡時，就會釋出TNF以促使病毒感染的細胞自殺死亡。無論是外生或內生路徑，最後都是使細胞產生同樣的蛋白酶和核酸酶以崩解細胞的結構及DNA。

由於細胞的提早死亡，以致於病毒無法完成其複製作用。病毒為了求生存，必然會與細胞爭奪細胞死亡機制的掌控權。所以說細胞計劃性死亡對病毒產生了選汰壓力。有致病力的病毒通常都能阻止細胞自殺，而且每種病毒都有其獨特的策略。藉由研究病毒抑制細胞自殺的策略，使我們能進一步瞭解細胞計畫性死亡的複雜反應路徑。

(B) 能殺死入侵病毒

(C) 是病毒增殖的策略

(D) 致病性強的病毒易引起細胞進行計劃性死亡

(E) 對病毒具自然選汰的作用

Scientists have found that a cell infected by a virus will, before the virus multiplies in large numbers, activate a suicide mechanism and end its life early, so as to limit the multiplication of the virus.

Programmed cell death can be achieved through an extrinsic response pathway or an intrinsic response pathway. In the intrinsic pathway, sensor molecules in the cell (such as the p53 protein) transmit a death signal to the mitochondria, which finally not only destroys the mitochondria but also causes the cell to die; in the extrinsic pathway, a death-signal receptor on the cell membrane is activated by a death-signal molecule from outside the cell (such as the TNF protein) and likewise starts the cell suicide response, but this response does not go through the mitochondria and instead directly activates enzymes in the cytoplasm to dismantle the cell. The death-signal molecules of the extrinsic pathway come from many sources; for example, when our natural killer cells detect traces of a virus, they release TNF to cause the virus-infected cell to commit suicide. Whether through the extrinsic or the intrinsic pathway, in the end the cell produces the same proteases and nucleases to break down the structure and DNA of the cell.

Because the cell dies early, the virus cannot complete its replication. In order to survive, viruses inevitably contest with the cell for control of the cell-death mechanism. Therefore programmed cell death exerts a selective pressure on viruses. Pathogenic viruses can usually prevent cell suicide, and each virus has its own unique strategy. By studying the strategies by which viruses inhibit cell suicide, we can further understand the complex response pathways of programmed cell death.

細胞計劃性死亡(Apoptosis)，又稱之為細胞自殺作用，是我們對抗病毒感染的重要防禦機制。病毒是絕對細胞內寄生體。病毒一旦侵入細胞，便立刻主導細胞的生化工廠合成本身所需的物質，並複製出大量的子病毒。科學家發現被病毒感染的細胞會在病毒大量增殖前，啟動自殺機制提早結束生命以限制病毒增殖。

細胞計畫性死亡可藉外生反應路徑或者是內生反應路徑達成。在內生路徑中，細胞內的感應分子(如p53蛋白質)會將死亡訊號傳遞至粒線體，最後不僅破壞粒線體也使細胞死亡；而在外生路徑中，細胞膜上的死亡訊號受體被來自細胞外的死亡訊號分子(如TNF蛋白質)活化後，也會啟動細胞自殺反應，不過本反應不經粒線體，而是直接活化細胞質中的酵素以瓦解細胞。外生路徑中的死亡訊號分子的來源有多種，例如當我們的自然殺手細胞發現病毒蹤跡時，就會釋出TNF以促使病毒感染的細胞自殺死亡。無論是外生或內生路徑，最後都是使細胞產生同樣的蛋白酶和核酸酶以崩解細胞的結構及DNA。

由於細胞的提早死亡，以致於病毒無法完成其複製作用。病毒為了求生存，必然會與細胞爭奪細胞死亡機制的掌控權。所以說細胞計劃性死亡對病毒產生了選汰壓力。有致病力的病毒通常都能阻止細胞自殺，而且每種病毒都有其獨特的策略。藉由研究病毒抑制細胞自殺的策略，使我們能進一步瞭解細胞計畫性死亡的複雜反應路徑。

Reading 3: Questions 40–41 form a group.

In the environment, there are many chemical substances that have a negative effect on the action of hormones in the human endocrine system. These chemical substances are called "endocrine disrupter substances (EDS)". EDS need only a low concentration to take effect, so scientists also call them "environmental hormones". These chemical substances are not easily decomposed in the environment and they accumulate; through bioaccumulation they affect human health and ecosystems. About seventy environmental hormones are currently known, of which more than forty are pesticide components, and the others are mostly chlorinated compounds (polychlorinated biphenyls, dioxins, etc.) and plastic raw materials.

More than twenty years ago, a poisoning incident caused by polychlorinated biphenyls in rice bran oil occurred in central Taiwan, causing the deaths of many fetuses, and incomplete development, breathing disorders and abnormal reproductive organs in infants. The male infants poisoned that year, after growing up, had sperm of poorer quality than ordinary people, and even abnormalities. In addition, the insecticide DDT, commonly used in earlier years, is also a kind of environmental hormone. Research reports have now pointed out that DDT feminizes wild animals, lowers sperm counts in men and increases the incidence of breast cancer in women. Although advanced countries such as those of Europe, America and Japan have banned the manufacture and use of DDT, many Third World countries still use it, and DDT accumulates in the fatty tissue of the body and may be passed on to the next generation through nursing.

環境中，有許多化學物質會對人體內分泌荷爾蒙的作用產生負面影響。這些化學物質稱為「內分泌干擾物質（Endocrine Disrupter Substance），簡稱EDS」。EDS僅需低濃度，即可以發揮作用，因此科學家們又稱其為「環境賀爾蒙」。這些化學物質，在環境中不易分解且會蓄積，經生物累積作用，而影響人類健康及生態體系。目前已知的環境賀爾蒙約有七十種，其中四十餘種為農藥成分，其他則多為含氯化合物(多氯聯苯、戴奧辛等)和塑膠原料等。

二十多年前，台灣中部曾經發生米糠油的多氯聯苯中毒事件，造成多名胎兒死亡，幼兒發育不全、呼吸障礙、及生殖器官異常等情形。當年中毒的男嬰，長大成人後，其精蟲品質較一般人為差，甚至有異常的現象。另外，早年常用的殺蟲劑DDT，也是環境賀爾蒙的一種。目前已有研究報告指出，DDT會使野生動物雌性化，使男人精蟲量下降、女人乳癌的罹患率增加。雖然歐、美和日本等先進國家已經禁止製造與使用DDT，但是許多第三世界國家仍在使用，DDT會積存在身體的脂肪組織，透過哺乳行為而有可能傳給下一代。

When biological researchers carry out ecological and evolutionary studies, they often need to know the population size of the target species, and the mark-recapture method is a method frequently used to estimate population size. The method can be briefly expressed as follows:

$N = M \times R / R_m$

N: population size

M: number of individuals captured and marked in the first capture

R: number of individuals recaptured

$R_m$: number of marked individuals among those recaptured

(C) 0.1

(D) 1

[Single choice]

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

The process of photosynthesis in green plants is often divided into two stages, the "light reactions" and the "dark reactions". The step in the dark reactions that fixes carbon dioxide is catalyzed by an enzyme abbreviated as Rubisco, and the activity of this enzyme is regulated by multiple factors. Research results show that a lower hydrogen ion concentration and a higher magnesium ion concentration in the chloroplast stroma favor the expression of its enzymatic activity; furthermore, light enhances the activity of "Rubisco activase" and thereby raises the activity of the Rubisco enzyme. In addition, it has also been reported that in the dark, mesophyll cells continuously produce an inhibitor molecule of Rubisco, but under light conditions this inhibitor molecule is broken down and loses its effect. Besides Rubisco, at least 4 other enzymes participating in the dark reactions are currently known to also require light in order to be activated. Therefore, the dark reactions of photosynthesis not only need to use the products of the light reactions but also need light to activate the various enzymes taking part in the reactions, so the progress of the "dark reactions" of photosynthesis is not entirely unrelated to light.

Based on the text above, answer Questions 36–38:

(C) The importance of light for the "dark reactions"

(D) The relationship between the "light reactions" and the "dark reactions"

閱讀一

綠色植物進行光合作用的過程常被區分為「光反應」和「暗反應」二個階段。暗反應中固定二氧化碳的步驟是由簡稱為Rubisco 的酵素負責催化進行，該酵素的活性會受到多重因子的調控。有研究結果顯示，葉綠體基質內氫離子濃度降低與鎂離子濃度提昇，有利於其酵素活性的表現；再者，光照可增進「Rubisco 活化酵素」(Rubisco activase) 的活性，以提昇Rubisco 酵素的活性。此外，也有報導指出，在黑暗中，葉肉細胞會持續生成Rubisco 的抑制分子，但在光照條件下，該抑制分子會分解而失去其作用。除了Rubisco 之外，目前已知至少還有其他4 種參與暗反應的酵素也需要照光才能被活化。因此，光合作用的暗反應不僅需要利用光反應的產物，同時也需要光照以活化多種參與其反應的酵素，所以，光合作用「暗反應」的進行並不是完全與光照無關。

[Single choice]

Reading 2: Questions 39–42 form a group.

When genes are expressed in eukaryotic cells, the precursor mRNA (pre-mRNA) transcribed from DNA, after the addition of a 5' cap (Gppp) and a 3' poly(A) tail, must also undergo splicing, in which introns are removed and exons are joined, before it becomes mature mRNA. In general, one gene produces one kind of mature mRNA and one kind of protein. However, for some genes, after transcription their instructions are edited by the cell through alternative splicing and RNA editing. After such editing, a small group of genes can produce a large group of proteins of different kinds and functions, thus increasing the uses of the genes.

Alternative splicing includes removing a certain exon, retaining a certain intron, choosing among multiple splice sites at the 5' or 3' end of an intron, or retaining different combinations of exons in different splicing forms. For example, the mouse $\alpha$-tropomyosin gene, which regulates muscle contraction, contains 14 exons, of which 6 form 3 pairs, and in each pair only 1 is retained in the mature mRNA; thus, as a result of alternative splicing, a total of 10 different $\alpha$-tropomyosin proteins are produced in different tissues. RNA editing means modifying the nucleotide sequence of the pre-mRNA before translation, and the main forms of modification include base-substitution editing and base insertion or deletion editing. The human apoB gene is an example of base-substitution editing: in liver cells the apoB gene is expressed as the ApoB-100 protein (the number indicates the number of amino acids composing this protein), but in small intestine cells it is expressed as the ApoB-48 protein (the number indicates the number of amino acids composing this protein). In small intestine cells, the C in a certain CAA codon near the middle of the apoB mRNA is edited to U, thereby newly generating a stop codon for protein synthesis, so that the molecular weight of the translated protein is halved.

Based on the text above, answer Questions 39–42:

(A) Ribosome

(B) Nucleus

(C) Cytoplasm

(D) Endoplasmic reticulum

[單選題]

閱讀二

真核細胞基因表現時，由DNA 轉錄出的前驅mRNA (pre-mRNA)，經加上5'端帽 (Gppp) 及3'端聚腺嘌呤[poly(A) tail]後，還需經裁接的過程將中斷子 (intron) 切除及表現子 (exon) 接合，才成為成熟的mRNA。一般來說，一個基因生成一種成熟的mRNA 及一種蛋白質。不過有些基因經轉錄後，其指令會被細胞以選擇性裁接法 (alternative splicing) 與RNA 編輯法 (RNA editing) 編輯。經過這樣的編輯後，就可讓一小群的基因，產生一大群不同種類與功能的蛋白質，來增加基因的用途。

選擇性的裁接包括裁掉某一表現子、保留某一中斷子、多種選擇中斷子的5'端或3'端的裁接點、或在不同裁接形式中保留不同組合的表現子等。如老鼠調節肌肉收縮的 $\alpha$-tropomyosin 基因包含14 個表現子，其中6 個組成3 對，每對中僅有1 個會被保留在成熟的mRNA 上，故選擇性裁接的結果，導致在不同的組織中，共生成10 種不同的 $\alpha$-tropomyosin 蛋白質。RNA 編輯是指在轉譯前將前驅mRNA 上的核苷酸序列加以修改，主要的修改形式包括鹽基置換編輯及鹽基插入或移除編輯。人的apoB 基因即為鹽基置換編輯的一個例子，在肝臟細胞中apoB 基因表現出ApoB-100 蛋白質(其中的數字表示組成此蛋白質的胺基酸數目)，但在小腸細胞中則表現出ApoB-48 蛋白質(其中的數字表示組成此蛋白質的胺基酸數目)。在小腸細胞中，apoB mRNA 上靠近中間位置的某一CAA 密碼子上的C 被編輯為U，於是新生成一蛋白質合成的終止密碼，導致轉譯的蛋白質分子量減半。

[Single choice]

Reading 3: Questions 43–45 form a group.

The symptoms of asthma are contraction of the tracheal (airway) smooth muscle, so that the radius of the airway becomes smaller and airflow in breathing is obstructed; the amount of mucus secreted in the patient's airway also increases, making the already narrowed airway even more obstructed; in addition, patients are also very sensitive to allergens, irritants, and bacterial or viral infections, and even cold air can cause their airways to overreact.

The pathological mechanism of asthma is very complex and is related to the autonomic nerves that innervate the airway; sympathetic nerves can cause airway smooth muscle to relax, whereas the vagus nerve causes airway smooth muscle to contract. The acetylcholine released from vagal nerve endings acts on muscarinic receptors on smooth muscle cells; there are five subtypes of this receptor, and the muscarinic receptor of airway smooth muscle cells is the $\mathrm{M_3}$ subtype. Interestingly, vagal nerve endings also have receptors, which belong to the $\mathrm{M_2}$ subtype. When the vagus nerve is excited, the acetylcholine released from its endings acts not only on $\mathrm{M_3}$ receptors but also on $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptors. Acetylcholine acting on $\mathrm{M_3}$ receptors causes airway smooth muscle contraction, but acting on $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptors it inhibits the release of acetylcholine; in other words, the $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptor regulates the release of acetylcholine by a negative feedback mechanism. Recently, it has been found that viruses damage $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptors so that they lose their function, causing the patient's airway to overreact and the condition to become more severe.

The vagus nerve that innervates the airway also contains another kind of unmyelinated nerve fiber, called the C fiber, which is a sensory nerve. When C fibers are stimulated, on the one hand they transmit information into the central nervous system, causing a reflex action, and on the other hand their nerve endings release substance P, causing airway smooth muscle contraction and increased glandular secretion. This kind of nerve fiber is very special: even if drugs are used to block the actions of both the sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves, the endings of C fibers continue to release neurotransmitters, so they are called non-sympathetic, non-parasympathetic nerves. For many years, scientists have known that the endings of C fibers have capsaicin receptors (capsaicin is a component extracted from red chili peppers). A recent report found that the capsaicin receptor is itself an ion channel; many irritant molecules and particles in the air, and even temperature changes, can cause this ion channel to open, allowing calcium ions and sodium ions to enter and excite the C fiber.

Based on the text above, answer Questions 43–45:

43. Which of the following would make asthma more severe? (single choice)

(A) Allergens or cold air

(B) An excessive decrease in acetylcholine

(C) Increased secretion of norepinephrine

(D) Enhanced function of the muscarinic receptor $\mathrm{M_2}$ subtype

[單選題]

閱讀三

氣喘的症狀是氣管平滑肌收縮，以致氣管半徑變小，呼吸氣流不順暢；患者氣管的粘液分泌量還會增加，使得已經狹窄的氣管更不順暢；此外，患者也對過敏原、刺激性物質、細菌或病毒感染非常敏感，甚至冷空氣都會促使其氣管過度反應。

氣喘的病理機制非常複雜，與支配氣管的自主神經有關；交感神經能促使氣管平滑肌舒張，而迷走神經卻使氣管平滑肌收縮。迷走神經末梢釋出的乙醯膽鹼，會作用於平滑肌細胞上的蕈鹼受器(體)，這種受器有五種亞型，氣管平滑肌細胞的蕈鹼受器是 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 亞型受器，有趣的是迷走神經末梢也有受器，屬於 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 亞型受器。迷走神經興奮時，其末梢所釋出的乙醯膽鹼，除作用於 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 受器外，也會作用於 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器，乙醯膽鹼作用於 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 受器會引起氣管平滑肌收縮，但作用於 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器卻抑制乙醯膽鹼釋放，換句話說，$\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器係以一種負回饋作用機制來調節乙醯膽鹼的釋放。爾來，發現濾過性病毒會傷害 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器，使之喪失功能，引起病患的氣管過度反應，病情更為嚴重。

支配氣管的迷走神經尚含有另一種無鞘神經纖維，稱為C 纖維，屬於感覺神經。當C 纖維受到刺激時，一方面將訊息傳入中樞神經，引起反射作用，另一方面是其神經末梢會釋放P 物質，引起氣管平滑肌收縮、腺體分泌增多。這種神經纖維非常特殊，即使利用藥物將交感神經與副交感神經的作用全都阻斷，C 纖維末梢會繼續釋放神經傳遞物，因此有非交感神經非副交感神經之稱。多年來，科學家都知道C 纖維神經末梢有辣椒素受器 (辣椒素是從紅辣椒所提煉的成份)。最近的報告發現，辣椒素受器本身就是一種離子通道，空氣中許多刺激性分子、微粒、甚至是溫度變化等，都會促使這種離子通道開啟，使鈣離子與鈉離子進入並興奮C 纖維。

根據上文，回答43-45 題：

43. 下列何者會促使氣喘更為嚴重？(單選)

(A) 過敏原或冷空氣

(B) 乙醯膽鹼過度降低

(C) 正腎上腺素分泌增強

(D) 蕈鹼受器 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 亞型的功能增強

氣喘的病理機制非常複雜，與支配氣管的自主神經有關；交感神經能促使氣管平滑肌舒張，而迷走神經卻使氣管平滑肌收縮。迷走神經末梢釋出的乙醯膽鹼，會作用於平滑肌細胞上的蕈鹼受器(體)，這種受器有五種亞型，氣管平滑肌細胞的蕈鹼受器是 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 亞型受器，有趣的是迷走神經末梢也有受器，屬於 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 亞型受器。迷走神經興奮時，其末梢所釋出的乙醯膽鹼，除作用於 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 受器外，也會作用於 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器，乙醯膽鹼作用於 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 受器會引起氣管平滑肌收縮，但作用於 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器卻抑制乙醯膽鹼釋放，換句話說，$\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器係以一種負回饋作用機制來調節乙醯膽鹼的釋放。爾來，發現濾過性病毒會傷害 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 受器，使之喪失功能，引起病患的氣管過度反應，病情更為嚴重。

支配氣管的迷走神經尚含有另一種無鞘神經纖維，稱為C 纖維，屬於感覺神經。當C 纖維受到刺激時，一方面將訊息傳入中樞神經，引起反射作用，另一方面是其神經末梢會釋放P 物質，引起氣管平滑肌收縮、腺體分泌增多。這種神經纖維非常特殊，即使利用藥物將交感神經與副交感神經的作用全都阻斷，C 纖維末梢會繼續釋放神經傳遞物，因此有非交感神經非副交感神經之稱。多年來，科學家都知道C 纖維神經末梢有辣椒素受器 (辣椒素是從紅辣椒所提煉的成份)。最近的報告發現，辣椒素受器本身就是一種離子通道，空氣中許多刺激性分子、微粒、甚至是溫度變化等，都會促使這種離子通道開啟，使鈣離子與鈉離子進入並興奮C 纖維。

(A) 直接作用於氣管平滑肌

(B) 使蕈鹼受器 $\mathrm{M_3}$ 亞型失去作用

(C) 使蕈鹼受器 $\mathrm{M_2}$ 亞型失去作用

(D) 興奮副交感神經因而釋出過多的乙醯膽鹼

(E) 使釋放乙醯膽鹼的負回饋調節作用喪失

Reading 3: Questions 43–45 form a group.

The symptoms of asthma are contraction of the tracheal (airway) smooth muscle, so that the radius of the airway becomes smaller and airflow in breathing is obstructed; the amount of mucus secreted in the patient's airway also increases, making the already narrowed airway even more obstructed; in addition, patients are also very sensitive to allergens, irritants, and bacterial or viral infections, and even cold air can cause their airways to overreact.

The pathological mechanism of asthma is very complex and is related to the autonomic nerves that innervate the airway; sympathetic nerves can cause airway smooth muscle to relax, whereas the vagus nerve causes airway smooth muscle to contract. The acetylcholine released from vagal nerve endings acts on muscarinic receptors on smooth muscle cells; there are five subtypes of this receptor, and the muscarinic receptor of airway smooth muscle cells is the $\mathrm{M_3}$ subtype. Interestingly, vagal nerve endings also have receptors, which belong to the $\mathrm{M_2}$ subtype. When the vagus nerve is excited, the acetylcholine released from its endings acts not only on $\mathrm{M_3}$ receptors but also on $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptors. Acetylcholine acting on $\mathrm{M_3}$ receptors causes airway smooth muscle contraction, but acting on $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptors it inhibits the release of acetylcholine; in other words, the $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptor regulates the release of acetylcholine by a negative feedback mechanism. Recently, it has been found that viruses damage $\mathrm{M_2}$ receptors so that they lose their function, causing the patient's airway to overreact and the condition to become more severe.

The vagus nerve that innervates the airway also contains another kind of unmyelinated nerve fiber, called the C fiber, which is a sensory nerve. When C fibers are stimulated, on the one hand they transmit information into the central nervous system, causing a reflex action, and on the other hand their nerve endings release substance P, causing airway smooth muscle contraction and increased glandular secretion. This kind of nerve fiber is very special: even if drugs are used to block the actions of both the sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves, the endings of C fibers continue to release neurotransmitters, so they are called non-sympathetic, non-parasympathetic nerves. For many years, scientists have known that the endings of C fibers have capsaicin receptors (capsaicin is a component extracted from red chili peppers). A recent report found that the capsaicin receptor is itself an ion channel; many irritant molecules and particles in the air, and even temperature changes, can cause this ion channel to open, allowing calcium ions and sodium ions to enter and excite the C fiber.

Based on the text above, answer Questions 43–45:

45. Which of the following statements about C fibers and substance P are correct? (multiple choice)

(A) Excitation of C fibers can cause asthma

(B) Using a parasympathetic blocker can inhibit excitation of C fibers

(C) The capsaicin receptor is acted on only by capsaicin

(D) Substance P causes calcium ions and sodium ions to enter C fibers

(E) Substances that can block the release of substance P have potential to be developed into drugs for treating asthma

49. IV. The stretch reflex is an important physiological response by which we maintain body posture and balance in daily life; this reflex is related to the stretching of the muscle spindle (a stretch receptor). The muscle spindle is spindle-shaped and contains muscle fibers arranged parallel to the extrafusal skeletal muscle. The muscle fibers within the muscle spindle are supplied by Ia sensory nerves (Figure 5). When skeletal muscle is stretched by an external force (such as a heavy object in the hand), the fibers inside the muscle spindle are stretched at the same time and become excited, and transmit the signal to the sensory neurons distributed in the muscle spindle, thereby producing the stretch reflex. Figure 5 shows the neural pathway of the stretch reflex when the palm supports an object of 100 grams; arrows indicate the direction of nerve impulse conduction. Reading 1: Questions 36–39 form a group.

There are more than one million species of animals in the world. Apart from birds and mammals, fewer than fifteen thousand species in all, which are warm-blooded animals, the vast majority are cold-blooded (poikilothermic) animals. From the viewpoint of energy use, cold-blooded animals are a very efficient group: their metabolic rate is low, so little heat energy is wasted. Ordinary warm-blooded animals can convert only about 2% of the energy in their food into their own body substance, whereas the conversion rate of cold-blooded animals is mostly around 50%. When food is scarce, cold-blooded animals can withstand hunger, and they can still survive in environments where the food supply is very unstable or where food appears only briefly once a year. In variation of body form, cold-blooded animals are also almost unrestricted: in both size and shape they can develop fully, making full use of the different niches of the ecosystem and enriching the biodiversity of the Earth.

It is known that reptiles appeared roughly in the Paleozoic Era and dominated the Earth in the Mesozoic Era, while mammals appeared roughly in the Mesozoic Era and reached their flourishing state in the Cenozoic Era. Researchers found skeletal fossils of some predators and prey in rock strata of the Paleozoic Era and, after estimating their body weights separately, calculated the ratio of the total body weight of the predators to the total body weight of the prey as 50 : 100. They also found many mammal fossils in rock strata of the Cenozoic Era, and, using the same method, estimated the ratio of the total body weight of predator mammals to the total body weight of prey mammals as 2 : 100.

Based on this text and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

36. The primary, secondary and tertiary consumers of a pond ecosystem are zooplankton, crustaceans and fishes respectively. What should be the closest ratio of the total body weights of the primary, secondary and tertiary consumers? (single choice)

(A) 1 : 10 : 100

(B) 1 : 50 : 500

(C) 100 : 50 : 25

(D) 100 : 50 : 1

[單選題]

閱讀一

全世界有一百萬種以上的動物，除了不到一萬五千種的鳥類和哺乳類是溫血動物外，其他絕大多數都屬於冷血(變溫)動物。從能量利用的角度來看，冷血動物是非常有效的一群，牠們的新陳代謝率低，所以浪費掉的熱能也少。一般溫血動物只能從食物轉換約2%的能量成為自己的體質，而冷血動物的轉換率多在50%左右。當食物不足時，冷血動物能耐飢餓，在食物來源很不穩定或食物每年只短暫出現一次的環境，仍可以生存。在體型的變化上，冷血動物也幾乎沒有限制，不管是大小還是形狀，牠們都可以充分發揮，充分地利用生態系的不同棲位，豐富了地球的生物多樣性。

已知爬行動物約出現在古生代，並在中生代稱霸地球，而哺乳類約出現在中生代，至新生代達到興盛狀態。研究人員在古生代的岩層中發現一些掠食者和被掠食者的骨骼化石，經分別估算其體重後，算出掠食者的總體重和被掠食者的總體重比值為50：100。另外他們在新生代的岩層內也曾找到許多哺乳類的化石，用同樣的方法，估算出掠食者哺乳類和被掠食者哺乳類的總體重比值為2：100。

試根據本文及相關知識，回答下列問題：

(A)1：10：100

(B)1：50：500

(C)100：50：25

(D)100：50：1

全世界有一百萬種以上的動物，除了不到一萬五千種的鳥類和哺乳類是溫血動物外，其他絕大多數都屬於冷血(變溫)動物。從能量利用的角度來看，冷血動物是非常有效的一群，牠們的新陳代謝率低，所以浪費掉的熱能也少。一般溫血動物只能從食物轉換約2%的能量成為自己的體質，而冷血動物的轉換率多在50%左右。當食物不足時，冷血動物能耐飢餓，在食物來源很不穩定或食物每年只短暫出現一次的環境，仍可以生存。在體型的變化上，冷血動物也幾乎沒有限制，不管是大小還是形狀，牠們都可以充分發揮，充分地利用生態系的不同棲位，豐富了地球的生物多樣性。

Alzheimer's disease, also called senile dementia, is a neurodegenerative disease in which brain cells die because proteins are deposited in the cerebral cortex. Patients are mostly elderly people over 65 years of age, who gradually lose their memory and develop symptoms of language and emotional disorders.

In the early 19th century, scientists already knew that round plaques sometimes appear in the human cerebral cortex, and observed that they are composed of nerve fibers. In 1853, the German pathologist Virchow called these brain deposits amyloid deposits. In 1984, Glenner and Wong first isolated amyloid deposits from the meningeal blood vessels of Alzheimer's disease patients. Soon afterwards, Masters, Beyreuther and others also isolated amyloid deposits from the core of senile plaques, and the molecular weights and amino acid compositions of the two were the same. However, Abraham, Selkoe and others found that only the amyloid deposits in mature senile plaques had undergone chemical modification. In early 1987, the complementary DNA (cDNA for short) that synthesizes this protein was isolated, showing that the $\beta$-amyloid deposit protein, containing 42 amino acids, is only a small segment of the complete precursor protein (containing 695 amino acids). When the precursor protein is cleaved at specific positions by proteases, peptide fragments of 39 to 43 amino acids are produced, and the longer ones accumulate more easily. This $\beta$-amyloid deposit plays a key role in the development of senile dementia.

阿茲海默氏症(Alzheimer's disease)又稱老年癡呆症，是一種由於蛋白質在大腦皮質沈積而造成腦細胞死亡的神經退化性疾病。患者多為65歲以上老人，會漸漸喪失記憶，並且出現語言和情緒障礙的症狀。

19世紀早期，科學家已經知道人類的大腦皮質有時會出現圓形的斑塊，並觀察出它是由神經纖維所組成。1853年，德國病理學家菲爾克（Virchow）稱這些腦部沈積物為類澱粉沈積。1984年，格林納（Glenner）和翁（Wong）首先由阿茲海默氏症患者的腦膜血管中分離出類澱粉沈積。不久，馬士德（Masters）和貝倫索（Beyrenther）等人也由老化斑塊核心中分離出類澱粉沈積，兩者的分子量及胺基酸組成相同。但亞伯拉罕（Abraham）和塞克（Selkoe）等人發現，僅成熟老化斑塊中的類澱粉沈積有經過化學修飾。1987年初，合成這種蛋白質的互補DNA（complementary DNA，簡稱cDNA）被分離出來，顯示含有42個胺基酸的$\beta$型類澱粉沈積蛋白只是完整前驅蛋白（含695個胺基酸）的一小段。當前驅蛋白在特定位置被蛋白酶切割後，會產生介於39~43個胺基酸的胜肽片段，長度愈長的，愈容易產生堆積。此$\beta$型類澱粉沈積，在老年癡呆症發展過程中扮演著關鍵性的角色。

Reading 3: Questions 43–45 form a group.

Plasmodium and Toxoplasma are human parasites belonging to the same class of protozoa; infection causes malaria and toxoplasmosis respectively. Both have a special organelle called the apicoplast. The apicoplast is a trace left behind by two special endosymbiosis events. In the evolutionary history of eukaryotes, those in which prokaryotes were turned into intracellular organelles by endosymbiosis include, besides mitochondria, the chloroplast, which is believed to originate from cyanobacteria. According to the hypothesis on the origin of eukaryotes, the mitochondria of cells and the chloroplasts of higher plants are all organelles produced by one endosymbiosis and all have two membranes: an ancient eukaryote engulfed an ancestor of a bacterium or a cyanobacterium, and after the engulfed bacterium or cyanobacterium entered symbiosis with it, they evolved into mitochondria and chloroplasts respectively; this process is called primary endosymbiosis. Comparative studies of the apicoplast genes of Plasmodium and Toxoplasma show considerable similarity between them and the chloroplast genes of red algae, so the apicoplast is considered to be the result of an ancient secondary endosymbiosis event, in which a red alga was in turn engulfed by another eukaryote and formed its endosymbiotic organelle; therefore organelles of secondary endosymbiosis mostly have four membranes. Organisms currently known to have organelles of secondary endosymbiosis also include Euglena and brown algae, among others; although their origins are not the same, their organelles also all have circular DNA, similar to prokaryotes.

Although it originates from a red alga, the apicoplast of Plasmodium and Toxoplasma has no ability to carry out photosynthesis, and its main function is related to the synthesis of fatty acids. At present, genes for some enzymes of the fatty acid synthesis pathway, such as acetyl-carboxylase (the ACC gene), have been found in the apicoplast genome; they are quite similar to known bacterial and plant genes, whereas in animals similar genes have been found only in mitochondria, where they are related to the fatty acid synthesis of mitochondria. Because it possesses genes that the animal host does not have, the proteins encoded and translated by the apicoplast are completely different from the proteins in the human body. If a specific drug can recognize and destroy targets in this apicoplast, such as the ACC mentioned above, then this drug should not produce side effects in the human body. Scientists have also confirmed that some ACC inhibitors can, at specific concentrations, inhibit the growth of Toxoplasma without affecting human cells. Therefore, in the near future it may also be possible to find a drug with a specific target that is effective and has no side effects for treating malaria.

(D) Human genes

閱讀三

瘧原蟲和弓漿蟲是屬於同一類原生動物的人類寄生蟲，感染導致瘧疾和弓漿蟲病，兩者都有一種特殊的胞器，稱為端複胞器(apicoplast)。端複胞器是兩次特殊的內共生(endosymbiosis)事件所遺留下來的痕跡。在真核生物的演化史中，以內共生方式將原核生物轉變成細胞內胞器的，除了粒線體外，還有被認為是源自藍綠細菌的葉綠體。據真核生物起源假說的推測，細胞的粒線體和高等植物的葉綠體等，都是一次內共生所產生的胞器，皆具有兩層膜，即一個遠古真核生物吞噬了細菌或藍綠細菌的祖先，被吞噬的細菌或藍綠細菌與之共生後，分別演變成為粒線體及葉綠體，此過程稱為一次內共生。瘧原蟲和弓漿蟲端複胞器基因的比較研究，顯示它和紅藻葉綠體基因有相當大的相似度，因此端複胞器被認為是遠古二次內共生事件的結果，即一個紅藻又再度被另一個真核生物所吞噬，並形成其內共生的胞器，故二次內共生的胞器多具有四層膜。目前已知具有二次內共生胞器的生物尚包括了眼蟲(裸藻)、褐藻等，雖然它們的起源並不相同，但是它們的胞器也都具有環形的DNA，與原核生物相似。

雖然源自紅藻，但瘧原蟲和弓漿蟲的端複胞器並沒有進行光合作用的能力，它主要的功用與脂肪酸的合成有關。目前在端複胞器基因體中，已經發現了一些脂肪酸合成途徑的酵素基因如acetyl-carboxylase (ACC基因)，與已知的細菌和植物基因相當類似，但在動物中類似基因只發現在粒線體中，與粒線體的脂肪酸合成有關。由於具有動物宿主所沒有的基因，由端複胞器所編碼轉譯的蛋白質，與人體內的蛋白質完全不同。若某特定的藥物能辨識此端複胞器中，如上述的ACC，並進行破壞，那麼這個藥物對人體應不會產生副作用。目前科學家也已證實有一些ACC抑制劑在特定濃度下可以抑制弓漿蟲的生長，而不會影響人類細胞。因此不久的將來，也可能找到一種具有特定目標又有效且無副作用的藥劑來治療瘧疾了。

(B)阿拉伯芥

(C)嗜熱細菌

(D)人類基因

瘧原蟲和弓漿蟲是屬於同一類原生動物的人類寄生蟲，感染導致瘧疾和弓漿蟲病，兩者都有一種特殊的胞器，稱為端複胞器(apicoplast)。端複胞器是兩次特殊的內共生(endosymbiosis)事件所遺留下來的痕跡。在真核生物的演化史中，以內共生方式將原核生物轉變成細胞內胞器的，除了粒線體外，還有被認為是源自藍綠細菌的葉綠體。據真核生物起源假說的推測，細胞的粒線體和高等植物的葉綠體等，都是一次內共生所產生的胞器，皆具有兩層膜，即一個遠古真核生物吞噬了細菌或藍綠細菌的祖先，被吞噬的細菌或藍綠細菌與之共生後，分別演變成為粒線體及葉綠體，此過程稱為一次內共生。瘧原蟲和弓漿蟲端複胞器基因的比較研究，顯示它和紅藻葉綠體基因有相當大的相似度，因此端複胞器被認為是遠古二次內共生事件的結果，即一個紅藻又再度被另一個真核生物所吞噬，並形成其內共生的胞器，故二次內共生的胞器多具有四層膜。目前已知具有二次內共生胞器的生物尚包括了眼蟲(裸藻)、褐藻等，雖然它們的起源並不相同，但是它們的胞器也都具有環形的DNA，與原核生物相似。

雖然源自紅藻，但瘧原蟲和弓漿蟲的端複胞器並沒有進行光合作用的能力，它主要的功用與脂肪酸的合成有關。目前在端複胞器基因體中，已經發現了一些脂肪酸合成途徑的酵素基因如acetyl-carboxylase (ACC基因)，與已知的細菌和植物基因相當類似，但在動物中類似基因只發現在粒線體中，與粒線體的脂肪酸合成有關。由於具有動物宿主所沒有的基因，由端複胞器所編碼轉譯的蛋白質，與人體內的蛋白質完全不同。若某特定的藥物能辨識此端複胞器中，如上述的ACC，並進行破壞，那麼這個藥物對人體應不會產生副作用。目前科學家也已證實有一些ACC抑制劑在特定濃度下可以抑制弓漿蟲的生長，而不會影響人類細胞。因此不久的將來，也可能找到一種具有特定目標又有效且無副作用的藥劑來治療瘧疾了。

(C)它含有和藻類相似的基因

Reading 3: Questions 43–45 form a group.

Plasmodium and Toxoplasma are human parasites belonging to the same class of protozoa; infection causes malaria and toxoplasmosis respectively. Both have a special organelle called the apicoplast. The apicoplast is a trace left behind by two special endosymbiosis events. In the evolutionary history of eukaryotes, those in which prokaryotes were turned into intracellular organelles by endosymbiosis include, besides mitochondria, the chloroplast, which is believed to originate from cyanobacteria. According to the hypothesis on the origin of eukaryotes, the mitochondria of cells and the chloroplasts of higher plants are all organelles produced by one endosymbiosis and all have two membranes: an ancient eukaryote engulfed an ancestor of a bacterium or a cyanobacterium, and after the engulfed bacterium or cyanobacterium entered symbiosis with it, they evolved into mitochondria and chloroplasts respectively; this process is called primary endosymbiosis. Comparative studies of the apicoplast genes of Plasmodium and Toxoplasma show considerable similarity between them and the chloroplast genes of red algae, so the apicoplast is considered to be the result of an ancient secondary endosymbiosis event, in which a red alga was in turn engulfed by another eukaryote and formed its endosymbiotic organelle; therefore organelles of secondary endosymbiosis mostly have four membranes. Organisms currently known to have organelles of secondary endosymbiosis also include Euglena and brown algae, among others; although their origins are not the same, their organelles also all have circular DNA, similar to prokaryotes.

Although it originates from a red alga, the apicoplast of Plasmodium and Toxoplasma has no ability to carry out photosynthesis, and its main function is related to the synthesis of fatty acids. At present, genes for some enzymes of the fatty acid synthesis pathway, such as acetyl-carboxylase (the ACC gene), have been found in the apicoplast genome; they are quite similar to known bacterial and plant genes, whereas in animals similar genes have been found only in mitochondria, where they are related to the fatty acid synthesis of mitochondria. Because it possesses genes that the animal host does not have, the proteins encoded and translated by the apicoplast are completely different from the proteins in the human body. If a specific drug can recognize and destroy targets in this apicoplast, such as the ACC mentioned above, then this drug should not produce side effects in the human body. Scientists have also confirmed that some ACC inhibitors can, at specific concentrations, inhibit the growth of Toxoplasma without affecting human cells. Therefore, in the near future it may also be possible to find a drug with a specific target that is effective and has no side effects for treating malaria.

(B) Identifying specific genes of the apicoplast

(C) Studying the active sites of apicoplast proteins

(D) Using gene recombination technology to increase the rate of human fatty acid metabolism

(E) Reducing the frequency of mosquitoes appearing in places of human activity

Reading 1: Questions 35–38 form a group.

The 2005 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to B. Marshall and R. Warren in recognition of their discovery that the gastric bacterium Helicobacter pylori is the main cause of gastric ulcers. They found that this bacterium contains a large amount of urease, which can rapidly break down the urea $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2}$ in the host\'s gastric mucosa into $\mathrm{NH_3}$ and $\mathrm{CO_2}$. They therefore reasoned that if a patient took urea containing the isotope carbon ($^{13}\mathrm{C}$) and the bacterium was given enough time to break down the urea, then some of the carbon dioxide exhaled by the patient must be $^{13}\mathrm{CO_2}$. They therefore designed a simple "urea breath test" to check whether the stomach of a subject contains Helicobacter pylori. The urea breath test consists of the following four steps:

I. Before drinking the reagent, the subject first exhales one breath into the first bag and seals it.

II. The subject drinks the urea reagent containing the carbon isotope.

III. After 15–20 minutes, the subject exhales another breath into a second bag and seals it.

IV. The gases in the two bags are examined and the amounts of $^{13}\mathrm{CO_2}$ in them are compared, to determine whether the subject\'s stomach contains Helicobacter pylori.

Based on the text above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 35–38:

35. What is the purpose of the step "the subject first exhales one breath into the first bag and seals it"?

(A) To practise exhaling

(B) To test the instrument

(C) To serve as the experimental group

2005年諾貝爾生理醫學獎頒給B. Marshall和R. Warren，以表揚他們兩人發現胃幽門螺旋桿菌是造成胃潰瘍的主因。他們發現該細菌含有大量的尿素酶，可將寄主胃黏膜中的尿素$\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2}$快速分解為$\mathrm{NH_3}$和$\mathrm{CO_2}$。於是他們推想：若讓病人服用含有同位素碳($^{13}\mathrm{C}$)的尿素，並且讓該細菌有足夠的時間分解尿素，則病人呼出的二氧化碳中必定有些是$^{13}\mathrm{CO_2}$。因此設計了一套簡單的「尿素呼氣測試法」，以檢查受試者的胃中是否有胃幽門螺旋桿菌。尿素呼氣測試法的過程包含下列四個步驟：

一、喝試劑前，受試者先呼一口氣體封入第一個袋中。

二、受試者喝下含有碳同位素之尿素試劑。

三、經過15－20分鐘後，受試者再呼一口氣體封入第二個袋中。

四、檢驗兩袋氣體並比較其中$^{13}\mathrm{CO_2}$的含量，以判定受試者的胃中是否有胃幽門螺旋桿菌。

The 2006 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to the American scientists A.Z. Fire and C.C. Mello, who worked on nematodes, in recognition of their discovery of the phenomenon and technique of RNA interference (RNAi). The principle is as follows: during gene expression, when a specific gene is transcribed to produce a specific mRNA, if a small piece of RNA complementary to this specific mRNA appears in the cytoplasm and forms double-stranded RNA with it, enzymes are induced to break down this double-stranded RNA, so that this specific gene cannot be expressed. Based on this principle, if a small piece of RNA complementary to a specific mRNA is added artificially to the cytoplasm, the expression of a specific gene can be clearly suppressed. This RNAi technology can be applied in research on suppressing tumour growth and virus replication, and can also be used to "switch off" or "weaken" the expression of key genes that produce specific traits in cells. For example: although cotton seeds contain excellent protein, we do not use cotton seeds as food, because the gossypol in the seeds is toxic. The leaves, stems, seeds and flowers of cotton all contain gossypol, which is used to protect the plant from attack by pests and diseases. Botanists once succeeded in breeding gossypol-free varieties by hybridization, but because these are extremely vulnerable to pests and diseases, they cannot be grown on a large scale. Recently, scientists used RNAi technology to "weaken" the expression of a specific gene in the seeds, reducing their gossypol content by 98% while the content in other organs was unaffected, so the cotton plants still have the ability to resist pests and diseases.

Based on the text above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 39–42:

39. Which of the following can carry the genetic information for the synthesis of gossypol in cotton seeds from the nucleus to the cytoplasm?

(A) mRNA

(B) tRNA

(C) rRNA

(D) RNAi

閱讀二

2006年諾貝爾生理醫學獎頒給研究線蟲的美國科學家A.Z. Fire和C.C. Mello，以表彰他們發現RNA干擾現象(RNA interference，簡稱RNAi)及技術。其原理是在基因表現的過程中，若某特定基因轉錄產生特定的mRNA時，在細胞質中出現可與此特定mRNA互補的某一小段RNA，並與之形成雙股的RNA，就會誘發酵素分解此雙股RNA，使得這個特定基因無法表現。根據這樣的原理，如果用人工方法在細胞質中，加入可和某特定mRNA互補的一小段RNA，就能明確地抑制某特定基因的表現，這種RNAi技術可應用於抑制腫瘤生長和病毒複製的研究上，也可用於「關掉」或「減弱」細胞內產生特定性狀之關鍵基因的表現。例如：棉花種子雖然含有極佳的蛋白質，不過，我們不把棉花種子拿來當食物，因為種子中的棉子酚具有毒性。棉花的葉、莖、種子和花等都含有棉子酚，用來保護植株免受病蟲害的侵襲。植物學家曾經利用雜交的方式，成功地培育出不具棉子酚的品種，但因其極易受到病蟲害的侵襲，故無法大量培植。最近科學家利用RNAi技術，「減弱」種子內特定基因的表現，使其棉子酚含量減少98%，但其他器官的含量不受影響，故棉花植株仍具有抵抗病蟲害的能力。
