(A)mRNA

(B)tRNA

(C)rRNA

(D)RNAi

problems.problem:
[Single choice]

Reading 3: Questions 43–45 form a group.

Many chlorine-containing compounds, dioxins, DDT and so on, as well as the growth hormones or chemicals often used on animals in livestock farming, can, after entering the body of animals or humans, interfere with the action of hormones and cause disorders of the endocrine system; they are called "environmental hormones". Environmental hormones are not substances produced by the organism itself, but enter the organism from the external environment and affect the transport, regulation, receptor binding, signal generation, cellular metabolic reactions and so on of the normal hormones in the organism. Their mechanism of action may be that the environmental hormone molecules mimic, enhance or antagonize the action of the normal hormones in the organism. Scientists have found that at present the proportion of males in many animals is too low, the birth rate of baby boys worldwide shows signs of declining year by year, the age at which female secondary sex characteristics appear is gradually decreasing, the sperm density in male semen is decreasing, and male individuals are becoming feminized; the main cause of these problems is very likely environmental hormones.

Based on the text above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 43–45:

43. Which of the following is least related to environmental hormones?

(A) Decreased sperm density in semen

(B) Too low a proportion of males among animals

(C) Excessive population density in some countries

(D) Decreased age of breast development in females
problems.problem_orig:
[單選題]

閱讀三

許多含氯化合物、戴奧辛、ＤＤＴ……等，以及畜牧業經常使用於動物身上的生長激素或化學藥品，這些化學物質進入動物或人體後，會干擾賀爾蒙(激素)的作用，引起內分泌系統失調，稱之為「環境賀爾蒙」。環境賀爾蒙不是生物體本身所產生的物質，而是由外在環境進入生物體內，影響了生物體內正常賀爾蒙的運送、調節、受器結合、訊號產生、細胞代謝反應等，其作用機制可能透過環境賀爾蒙分子模仿、強化或拮抗生物體內正常賀爾蒙的作用。科學家發現當今許多動物雄性的比例過低，全球的男嬰出生率有逐年下滑的跡象，女性的第二性徵出現的年齡逐漸降低，男性精液中的精子密度降低，雄性個體雌性化，而造成這些問題的主要原因，極有可能就是環境賀爾蒙。

依據上文及習得的知識，回答43-45題：

(A)精液中精子密度降低

(B)動物雄性的比例過低

(C)某些國家人口過度密集

(D)女性乳房發育的年齡降低

許多含氯化合物、戴奧辛、ＤＤＴ……等，以及畜牧業經常使用於動物身上的生長激素或化學藥品，這些化學物質進入動物或人體後，會干擾賀爾蒙(激素)的作用，引起內分泌系統失調，稱之為「環境賀爾蒙」。環境賀爾蒙不是生物體本身所產生的物質，而是由外在環境進入生物體內，影響了生物體內正常賀爾蒙的運送、調節、受器結合、訊號產生、細胞代謝反應等，其作用機制可能透過環境賀爾蒙分子模仿、強化或拮抗生物體內正常賀爾蒙的作用。科學家發現當今許多動物雄性的比例過低，全球的男嬰出生率有逐年下滑的跡象，女性的第二性徵出現的年齡逐漸降低，男性精液中的精子密度降低，雄性個體雌性化，而造成這些問題的主要原因，極有可能就是環境賀爾蒙。

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

The revolutionary development of evolutionary and taxonomic theory in the twentieth century originated from the ideas of the German entomologist Willi Hennig. He held that classification must reflect phylogenetic relationships, and that phylogenetic relationships can only be obtained by confirming common ancestry. He believed that when we analyze the phylogenetic relationships among organisms, variable homologous characters can be divided into the more primitive "ancestral characters" and the more advanced "derived characters", and only the shared possession of the same derived characters can serve as evidence that organisms are closely related and come from the same ancestor. Hennig further divided organisms into three types, "monophyletic groups", "paraphyletic groups" and "polyphyletic groups", defined respectively as follows. "Monophyletic group": its members evolved from the same common ancestor and include all the members that evolved from this ancestor; "paraphyletic group": its members evolved from the same common ancestor but do not include all the members that evolved from this ancestor; "polyphyletic group": its members evolved from different ancestors. Hennig pointed out that only "monophyletic groups" are valid taxa, whereas "paraphyletic groups" and "polyphyletic groups" are not. Hennig's theory is called cladistics.

Figure 7 is a phylogenetic diagram of birds and reptiles drawn by a scholar according to Hennig's theory.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eisatopon/biology-olympiads-bank/main/images/twbio-2008-1-fig7.png

Figure labels (Chinese → English): 鳥龜 → turtle; 蛇 → snake; 蜥蜴 → lizard; 鱷魚 → crocodile; 翼龍 → pterosaur; 草食恐龍 → herbivorous dinosaur; 肉食恐龍 → carnivorous dinosaur; 始祖鳥 → Archaeopteryx; 鳥 → bird

演化與分類學理論於二十世紀有了革命性的發展，此發展源自德國昆蟲學者威利．赫尼格的主張。認為分類必須反映親緣關係，而親緣關係只能藉由共祖關係的確認獲致。他認為當我們分析生物間的親緣關係時，可以將有變異的同源特徵分為較為原始的「祖先特徵」以及較為進化的「衍生特徵」，而共同擁有相同的衍生特徵才能當作生物親緣關係接近來自同一祖先的證據。赫尼格還進一步將生物分為「單系群」、「並系群」與「複系群」等三類，分別定義為「單系群」：成員演化自同一共同祖先，並包含由此一祖先演化出來的所有成員；「並系群」：成員演化自同一共同祖先，但是沒有包含由此一祖先演化出來的所有成員；「複系群」：成員演化自不同祖先。赫尼格指出只有「單系群」才是合理的分類群，「並系群」與「複系群」則否。赫尼格的理論被稱為支序系統學。

Since ancient times people have often used garlic in cooking and medicine. Garlic contains various antioxidants such as vitamins A, C and E and selenium, which can scavenge various free radicals and have a heart-protecting effect.

Reading 3: Questions 42–44 form a group.

Protein drugs can be produced by recombinant DNA technology: a plasmid carrying a foreign gene and a drug-resistance gene is introduced into Escherichia coli or Chinese hamster ovary cells, and the bacteria or cells are then cultured in a medium containing the antibiotic corresponding to the drug-resistance gene, so as to obtain the expression products of the foreign gene, such as insulin, interferon and lysosomal hydrolytic enzymes, which can be used to treat human diseases. Besides the above method, the mammary glands of transgenic animals (such as cattle and sheep) can also serve as an expression system for producing protein drugs. The method is to first construct a recombinant DNA and, by microinjection, insert this human foreign DNA into the fertilized eggs of the animal, so as to breed varieties carrying the transgene. This recombinant DNA contains the DNA sequences of the recombinant protein and of a promoter; the promoter fragment directs the transgenic animal to produce the human recombinant protein in the mammary gland, such as lactoferrin, clotting factors and growth hormone. After these animals are raised and bred on a large scale, the expressed recombinant protein can be extracted and purified from the milk and made into drugs.

The recombinant proteins produced in Escherichia coli, Chinese hamster ovary cells or the mammary glands of transgenic animals as described above have the same amino acid sequences as the proteins naturally produced by humans, and avoid the risk that products purified from the human body may carry infectious human diseases; only the post-translational modifications of the recombinant proteins may differ. Post-translational modifications of proteins include: oligosaccharides attached to the amino group ($\mathrm{-NH_2}$) of asparagine or to the hydroxyl group ($\mathrm{-OH}$) of the side chain (R) of serine/threonine, phosphate attached to the hydroxyl group of the side chain of serine/threonine/tyrosine, methyl and acetyl groups attached to the amino terminus of the protein, oxidation of the sulfhydryl group ($\mathrm{-SH}$) of the cysteine side chain to form disulfide bonds, removal of a few amino acids at the amino terminus, cleavage of the polypeptide chain at specific positions, or binding with metals; differences in such post-translational modifications may affect the biological activity of the protein.

Based on the text above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 42–44:

(A) To increase the function of the transgene

(B) To increase the drug resistance of the bacteria or cells

(C) To select the bacteria or cells that have been successfully transformed

(D) To promote the production of recombinant protein by the bacteria or cells

閱讀三

蛋白質藥物的生產，可藉重組DNA技術，將載有外源基因及抗藥基因的質體送入大腸桿菌或中國倉鼠卵巢細胞內，再利用含有抗藥基因所生成抗生素的培養基來培養細菌或細胞，進而得到外源基因的表現產物，如胰島素、干擾素、溶體水解酵素等，可應用在治療人類疾病。除上述方法外，基因轉殖動物（如牛、綿羊）的乳腺亦可作為生產蛋白質藥物的表現系統。其方法為先建構一個重組DNA，利用顯微注射法，將此人類外源DNA嵌入動物受精卵，藉以繁殖出具轉殖基因的品種。此一重組DNA包含了重組蛋白質及啟動子的DNA序列，啟動子片段將指示轉殖動物在乳腺生產人類重組蛋白質，如乳鐵素、凝血因子、生長激素等，將這些動物大規模飼養繁殖後，可以從乳汁中萃取與純化表現的重組蛋白質，製成藥物。

上述利用大腸桿菌、中國倉鼠卵巢細胞或基因轉殖動物的乳腺生產的重組蛋白質，與人類自然產生的蛋白質有相同的胺基酸序列，並可避免純化自人體的產品可能帶有傳染人類疾病的風險，唯重組蛋白質的轉譯後修飾可能會有所差異。蛋白質的轉譯後修飾包括：寡醣被接到天門冬醯胺的胺基（$\mathrm{-NH_2}$）或絲胺酸/酥胺酸側鏈（R）的羥基（$\mathrm{-OH}$）、磷酸被接到絲胺酸/酥胺酸/酪胺酸側鏈的羥基、甲基及乙醯基被接到蛋白質的胺基端、半胱胺酸側鏈的硫氫基（$\mathrm{-SH}$）氧化成雙硫鍵、胺基端少許胺基酸被移去、多胜肽鏈在特殊位置被斷裂或與金屬結合等，此等轉譯後修飾的差異可能影響蛋白質的生物活性。

(A)增加轉殖基因的功能

(B)增加細菌或細胞抗藥性

(C)篩選基因轉殖成功的細菌或細胞

(D)促進細菌或細胞生產重組蛋白質

上述利用大腸桿菌、中國倉鼠卵巢細胞或基因轉殖動物的乳腺生產的重組蛋白質，與人類自然產生的蛋白質有相同的胺基酸序列，並可避免純化自人體的產品可能帶有傳染人類疾病的風險，唯重組蛋白質的轉譯後修飾可能會有所差異。蛋白質的轉譯後修飾包括：寡醣被接到天門冬醯胺的胺基（$\mathrm{-NH_2}$）或絲胺酸/酥胺酸側鏈（R）的羥基（$\mathrm{-OH}$）、磷酸被接到絲胺酸/酥胺酸/酪胺酸側鏈的羥基、甲基及乙醯基被接到蛋白質的胺基端、半胱胺酸側鏈的硫氫基（$\mathrm{-SH}$）氧化成雙硫鍵、胺基端少許胺基酸被移去、多胜肽鏈在特殊位置被斷裂或與金屬結合等，此等轉譯後修飾的差異可能影響蛋白質的生物活性。

Phenylketonuria is a recessive autosomal genetic disease; in the United States one in every ten thousand newborns develops it. Patients lack the enzyme phenylalanine oxidase in the body and cannot metabolise phenylalanine into tyrosine. Excess phenylalanine accumulates in the body and is converted into toxic phenylpyruvic acid, which enters the cerebrospinal fluid, damages the development of the central nervous system and leads to mental retardation.

The degree of mental retardation in patients with phenylketonuria is related to the accumulated phenylpyruvic acid, so controlling the phenylalanine taken in with the diet can alleviate the symptoms of this genetic disease. Phenylalanine, methionine and tryptophan are all essential amino acids that cannot be synthesised in the body and must be supplied by the diet as raw materials for the synthesis of the body's proteins. If patients with phenylketonuria are given a special low-phenylalanine diet to reduce the production of phenylpyruvic acid, mental retardation can be prevented. This dietary treatment is generally continued until adolescence, when intellectual development is complete.

Wolbachia is a group of bacteria that infect arthropods and roundworms (nematodes). It was isolated from the house mosquito in 1936 by Herting and Wolbach but did not attract attention at the time; only in 1971, when scientists discovered that the sperm of male mosquitoes infected with a certain strain of Wolbachia kill mosquito eggs, did it attract the interest of researchers. It is now widely accepted in the scientific community that Wolbachia is the most widespread kind of parasitic microorganism in the world, and as many as 25–70% of insects may be infected by it. Interestingly, Wolbachia is also related to many human diseases, such as filariasis and elephantiasis caused by nematodes; the cause is the immune response of the human immune system to the Wolbachia living inside the nematodes. If the Wolbachia inside the nematodes is removed, not only do the nematodes die or become infertile, but the disease symptoms caused by the nematodes are also alleviated. Conversely, some Wolbachia can specifically infect the yellow fever mosquito (Aedes aegypti) and shorten its lifespan, so they can be used for disease control.

When researchers prepare artificial culture medium for animal cells in the laboratory, in addition to basic nutrients they often have to add bovine serum as a supplementary nutrient, and the medium is sterilised before use. Biology laboratories usually sterilise with a high-temperature, high-pressure autoclave, but because animal cell culture medium contains heat-labile components, and bacteria are mostly 0.5–10 micrometres ($\mu\mathrm{m}$) in size, the sterilisation method more commonly used at present is to filter the medium through a sterile filter membrane with a pore size of 0.2 micrometres. A skilled graduate student cultured animal cells in medium that had just been filter-sterilised and soon found that the cultured cells showed signs of infection by a pathogen. Because the student believed that his procedure had been extremely careful, and the equipment used to pipette or hold the cells had all been bought in sterile packaging, he suspected that the cause of the contamination was that the filter membrane he used was unclean. He therefore borrowed a new sterile filter membrane from the next-door laboratory to prepare the medium again, but the cells in the second culture still showed signs of infection by a pathogen. The student then suspected that the bovine serum he used contained a pathogen, so he borrowed new bovine serum from the next-door laboratory; the filter membrane used, however, was from the same batch as the one used to prepare the medium the first time. The animal cells in the third culture finally grew normally and no longer showed signs of infection by a pathogen.

When researchers prepare artificial culture medium for animal cells in the laboratory, in addition to basic nutrients they often have to add bovine serum as a supplementary nutrient, and the medium is sterilised before use. Biology laboratories usually sterilise with a high-temperature, high-pressure autoclave, but because animal cell culture medium contains heat-labile components, and bacteria are mostly 0.5–10 micrometres ($\mu\mathrm{m}$) in size, the sterilisation method more commonly used at present is to filter the medium through a sterile filter membrane with a pore size of 0.2 micrometres. A skilled graduate student cultured animal cells in medium that had just been filter-sterilised and soon found that the cultured cells showed signs of infection by a pathogen. Because the student believed that his procedure had been extremely careful, and the equipment used to pipette or hold the cells had all been bought in sterile packaging, he suspected that the cause of the contamination was that the filter membrane he used was unclean. He therefore borrowed a new sterile filter membrane from the next-door laboratory to prepare the medium again, but the cells in the second culture still showed signs of infection by a pathogen. The student then suspected that the bovine serum he used contained a pathogen, so he borrowed new bovine serum from the next-door laboratory; the filter membrane used, however, was from the same batch as the one used to prepare the medium the first time. The animal cells in the third culture finally grew normally and no longer showed signs of infection by a pathogen.

[Single choice]

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

The proliferative potential of mammalian cardiac muscle cells is limited; after acute injury the damaged cardiac muscle cannot regenerate properly, and fibrosis and scarring appear, which impairs cardiac function. In studies of heart development in rat embryos, scientists found that the activity of p38 MAP kinase is extremely low while the heart is growing, and that the activity of p38 MAP kinase is highest when the growth of cardiac muscle cells slows down or stops; the scientists therefore speculated that the function of p38 MAP kinase may be related to terminating cell division.

When scientists combined a p38 MAP kinase inhibitor with fibroblast growth factor 1 (FGF1) to treat rats with acute cardiac muscle injury, they successfully induced proliferation of the cardiac muscle cells of the rats. FGF1 can bind to the FGF1 receptor on the cell membrane of cardiac muscle cells and stimulate the growth of cardiac muscle cells. After rats with acute cardiac muscle injury received 4 weeks of treatment with FGF1 and the p38 MAP kinase inhibitor, cardiac function improved markedly. However, when the p38 MAP kinase inhibitor was used alone for treatment, although it could promote the division of cardiac muscle cells, it could not improve cardiac function. FGF1 may improve the survival of the regenerated cardiac muscle cells because it can promote angiogenesis. The above experimental results show that a cocktail-type drug combination mixing a p38 MAP kinase inhibitor and FGF1 growth factor may be used to improve the repair of cardiac muscle injury in patients with ischemic heart disease.

(B) The activity of p38 MAP kinase is too high

(D) The activity of FGF1 is too high

哺乳動物心肌細胞的增生潛能有限，急性傷害時損傷的心肌無法適當再生，會出現纖維化及疤痕，而影響心臟功能。從大鼠胚胎的心臟發育研究中，科學家發現在心臟生長時，p38 MAP激酶（kinase）的活性極低，而當心臟肌肉細胞生長減緩或停止時，p38 MAP激酶的活性最高，故科學家推測，p38 MAP激酶的功能可能與終止細胞分裂有關。

當科學家把p38 MAP激酶抑制劑與纖維母細胞生長因子1（FGF1）搭配在一起，來處理急性心肌受傷的大鼠，可成功的誘導大鼠心肌細胞增生。FGF1可與心肌細胞膜上的FGF1受器結合，刺激心肌細胞的生長。急性心肌損傷的大鼠接受4個星期的FGF1與p38 MAP激酶抑制劑治療後，心臟功能顯著改善。但單獨使用p38 MAP激酶抑制劑治療時，雖然可促進心肌細胞分裂，但無法改善心臟功能。FGF1可能因為可以增進血管新生（angiogenesis），而增進再生心肌細胞的存活。以上實驗結果顯示，混合使用p38 MAP激酶抑制劑與FGF1生長因子的雞尾酒式藥物組合，可能可以用來增進缺血性心臟病患者的心肌損傷修復。

[Single choice]

Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

Dementia was discovered in 1906 by the German physician Alzheimer, and is called Alzheimer disease; it is commonly known as senile dementia. Patients show decline of memory and cognitive function and abnormal behaviour, and some even have delusions, gradually losing the ability to adapt to social life. As the disease worsens, motor function gradually declines, the gait becomes slow and unsteady, and movement coordination is poor, resembling Parkinson disease. In the 1960s, scholars found that the central acetylcholine cells of patients had undergone pathological change; in particular, the cholinergic neural pathways projecting from subcortical tissue to the cerebral cortex and the limbic system were clearly degenerated, showing that more than one neurotransmitter is involved in this disease, which differs from Parkinson disease.

The central nervous tissue of patients contains plaques and tangles, which form when diseased nerve cells become entangled with certain substances. Plaques contain $\mathrm{A\beta}$ protein (abbreviated $\mathrm{A\beta}$), and tangles contain tau protein. $\mathrm{A\beta}$ is composed of 40-42 amino acids, and its precursor is the transmembrane protein APP. $\mathrm{A\beta}$ is soluble when first formed; in excess it combines with other substances and is deposited outside the cells. An inflammatory response and excessive mitochondrial oxidative stress both accelerate the deposition of $\mathrm{A\beta}$. More seriously, acetylcholinesterase, which breaks down acetylcholine, accelerates the deposition of insoluble $\mathrm{A\beta}$.

失智症是德國醫生Alzheimer在1906年發現，中譯為阿茲海莫症（Alzheimer disease），俗稱老人痴呆症。病人的記憶與認知機能衰退，行為偏差，甚至有些狂想，逐漸喪失了適應社會生活的能力。隨病情惡化，運動機能漸差，步伐緩慢、不穩，動作協調不佳，宛如巴金氏症（Parkinson disease）。1960年代，學者發現病人的中樞乙醯膽鹼細胞發生病變，尤其是從皮層下組織投射到大腦皮層和腦邊緣系統的膽鹼性神經徑路明顯退化，顯示涉及這種疾病的神經傳遞物不只一種，異於巴金氏症。

Dementia was discovered in 1906 by the German physician Alzheimer, and is called Alzheimer disease; it is commonly known as senile dementia. Patients show decline of memory and cognitive function and abnormal behaviour, and some even have delusions, gradually losing the ability to adapt to social life. As the disease worsens, motor function gradually declines, the gait becomes slow and unsteady, and movement coordination is poor, resembling Parkinson disease. In the 1960s, scholars found that the central acetylcholine cells of patients had undergone pathological change; in particular, the cholinergic neural pathways projecting from subcortical tissue to the cerebral cortex and the limbic system were clearly degenerated, showing that more than one neurotransmitter is involved in this disease, which differs from Parkinson disease.

The central nervous tissue of patients contains plaques and tangles, which form when diseased nerve cells become entangled with certain substances. Plaques contain $\mathrm{A\beta}$ protein (abbreviated $\mathrm{A\beta}$), and tangles contain tau protein. $\mathrm{A\beta}$ is composed of 40-42 amino acids, and its precursor is the transmembrane protein APP. $\mathrm{A\beta}$ is soluble when first formed; in excess it combines with other substances and is deposited outside the cells. An inflammatory response and excessive mitochondrial oxidative stress both accelerate the deposition of $\mathrm{A\beta}$. More seriously, acetylcholinesterase, which breaks down acetylcholine, accelerates the deposition of insoluble $\mathrm{A\beta}$.

Although plants cannot move, they have certain defence mechanisms against external damage; for example, they use hairs, spines, chitin or suberin on the body surface to protect the plant itself from injury; they also use secondary metabolites in vesicles (such as alkaloids and tannins) to defend against predators; and they even secrete chemicals that inhibit the seed germination or growth of other plants, so as to reduce competition for resources. The secondary metabolites of some plants can be used to make drugs, such as quinine. Whether or not herbivores or invaders are present, these defensive structures or chemicals are always present in the plant body.

Damage can also induce plants to produce defence mechanisms; for example, when a leaf is bitten by a parasitoid wasp, the plant quickly produces protease inhibitors that bind the digestive enzymes of herbivores. From experimental results on tomato it is known that an injured leaf cleaves systemin, an 18-amino-acid peptide, from a prosystemin precursor protein; systemin is transported through the cell walls or intercellular spaces of the injured tissue to the neighbouring phloem and is then transmitted to the whole plant. Systemin binds to a receptor on the cell membrane and causes jasmonic acid to be produced inside the cell, and signals the relevant genes in the nucleus, so that the whole plant produces protease inhibitors and achieves a defensive effect.

(B) The vesicles in the cells contain a fixed amount of chemical toxins that make people sick

(C) When the tissue is injured, alkaloids and tannins are produced that make people sick

(D) When the tissue is injured, protease inhibitors are produced that inhibit the function of digestive enzymes

閱讀三

植物雖不能動，但卻具有某些防禦機制以對抗外界的傷害，如利用體表的毛、刺、幾丁質或木栓質來保護植株本身免於受傷害；也會利用囊泡內的次級代謝物（如植物鹼和單寧酸等）來防禦掠食者；更會分泌化學物質抑制別種植物的種子萌芽或生長，以降低資源競爭。有些植物的次級代謝物可用於製藥，如奎寧（quinine）。無論草食動物或侵略者是否存在，這些防禦構造或化學物質一直存在植物體。

傷害也可誘導植物產生防禦機制，如葉片被寄生蜂咬傷時，植物會快速產生與草食動物消化酵素結合的蛋白酶抑制劑。從蕃茄的實驗結果得知，受傷的葉子會將系統素前驅蛋白切割出由18個胺基酸組成的系統素（systemin），經由受傷組織的細胞壁或細胞間隙運輸到鄰近的韌皮部，再傳送到整個植物體。系統素會與細胞膜的受器結合，引起細胞內產生茉莉酸（jasmonic acid），並傳訊給細胞核內相關的基因，使整株植物產生蛋白酶抑制劑，達到防禦的效果。

(B) 細胞囊泡內含定量的化學毒素，使人生病

(C) 組織受傷時，會產生植物鹼和單寧酸，使人生病

(D) 組織受傷時，會產生蛋白酶抑制劑，抑制消化酵素的功能

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

Currently about half of the world's population is infected with Helicobacter pylori. H. pylori is a Gram-negative bacterium with a spiral shape and flagella; it was found and cultured from gastric mucosa specimens by Australian physicians in 1983. When H. pylori infects the human body it secretes urease, which converts urea into alkaline ammonia to neutralise stomach acid, which favours its long-term survival in the stomach. Besides causing gastritis, H. pylori is also associated with the formation of duodenal ulcers and stomach cancer.

The interaction between H. pylori and the infected host gastric cells is very interesting. Studies have shown that when human gastric epithelial cells are infected by H. pylori, they secrete type 2 fucosidase (FUCA2), which catalyses the hydrolysis of fucose (L-fucose) on the oligosaccharide side chains of glycoproteins; H. pylori can take up the hydrolysis product fucose from the epithelial cells, which provides nutrients and energy for its growth. If RNA interference is used to reduce the expression of FUCA2 in epithelial cells, the ability of H. pylori to attach to the surface of epithelial cells is reduced, and in turn the transfer of its toxic molecule CagA into the epithelial cells is reduced, showing that FUCA2 is related to the pathogenicity of H. pylori. In addition, the expression of FUCA2 increases the formation of the Lewis X antigen of H. pylori; this sugar-molecule antigen helps H. pylori evade attack by the host immune system. FUCA2 may therefore become a new diagnostic marker for stomach diseases and a target for drug development.

Based on the passage above and what you have learned, answer Questions 36–38:

36. Which of the following helps Helicobacter pylori survive in the acidic environment of the human stomach?

(A) H. pylori secretes urease

(B) Human gastric cells secrete urease

(C) H. pylori secretes FUCA2

(D) Human gastric cells secrete FUCA2

目前全球約有一半的人口感染幽門螺旋桿菌（Helicobacter pylori）。幽門螺旋桿菌是一種具螺旋結構及鞭毛的革蘭氏陰性細菌，於1983年由澳洲醫師於胃黏膜標本中發現並培養出來。幽門螺旋桿菌感染人體時會分泌尿素酶，將尿素轉化為鹼性的氨以中和胃酸，利於長期存活在胃部。除了引起胃炎外，幽門螺旋桿菌也與十二指腸潰瘍及胃癌的形成相關。

Currently about half of the world's population is infected with Helicobacter pylori. H. pylori is a Gram-negative bacterium with a spiral shape and flagella; it was found and cultured from gastric mucosa specimens by Australian physicians in 1983. When H. pylori infects the human body it secretes urease, which converts urea into alkaline ammonia to neutralise stomach acid, which favours its long-term survival in the stomach. FUCA2 may therefore become a new diagnostic marker for stomach diseases and a target for drug development.

problems.problem:
[Single choice]

Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

Excessive food intake in the human body causes obesity; the excess energy is stored as glycogen in the liver and muscle or as triglycerides in adipose tissue.

The storage and intake of energy are regulated by hormones and nerves. After a normal meal, blood glucose rises and glucose is metabolised in pancreatic $\beta$ cells; the ATP produced causes the ATP-dependent $\mathrm{K^+}$ channels on the cell membrane to close, so the cell potential rises and $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ channels open, letting $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ enter the cell and causing insulin secretion, which promotes the uptake of blood glucose into the liver, muscle and adipose tissue. Conversely, if blood glucose is low, pancreatic $\alpha$ cells are stimulated to secrete glucagon, which acts on the liver and makes glycogen break down into glucose.

When adipose tissue stores too much triglyceride, the fat cells secrete leptin, which flows with the blood circulation to the hypothalamus and acts on the leptin receptors on anorexigenic (appetite-suppressing) neurons, exciting these neurons and at the same time inhibiting the feeding neurons there. Excitation of the anorexigenic neurons not only reduces food intake but also excites the sympathetic nerves that innervate adipose tissue, causing fat cells to oxidise fatty acids; the energy produced by this fatty acid oxidation is not ATP but heat, and the heat is released directly out of the body. The hypothalamus also passes signals to the medulla, exciting the vagus nerve that innervates the liver and inhibiting glucose synthesis in the liver. In animal experiments it was found that when the two leptin genes of mice are mutated, the body weight is 3 times that of normal mice.

(A) Calcium ions flow out of the $\beta$ cell

(B) Potassium ions enter the $\beta$ cell

(C) Pancreatic $\beta$ cells depolarise

(D) Glucagon causes blood glucose to increase

閱讀二

人體攝食過多將引起肥胖，過多的能量以肝醣儲存於肝臟與肌肉或是以三酸甘油酯儲存於脂肪組織。

能量的儲存或攝取受激素與神經的調控。日常攝食後，血糖增多，葡萄糖在胰臟$\beta$細胞進行代謝，產生ATP會促使細胞膜上依賴ATP的$\mathrm{K^+}$通道關閉，致細胞電位升高，開啟$\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$通道，讓$\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$進入細胞，引起胰島素分泌，促進血糖運入肝臟、肌肉與脂肪組織。相對地，若血糖低，則促進胰臟$\alpha$細胞分泌昇糖激素，作用於肝臟，使肝醣分解出葡萄糖。

當脂肪組織儲存過多的三酸甘油酯時，脂肪細胞會分泌瘦身素，隨血液循環流到下視丘，作用於厭食神經細胞上的瘦身素受體，使厭食細胞興奮，也同時抑制該處的攝食神經細胞。厭食細胞興奮，不但減少攝食，且會興奮支配脂肪組織的交感神經，促使脂肪細胞氧化脂肪酸，這種脂肪酸氧化產生的能量不是ATP而是熱，熱則直接散出體外。下視丘還會將訊息傳給延腦，興奮支配肝臟的迷走神經，抑制肝臟合成葡萄糖。動物實驗發現，小鼠兩個瘦身素基因突變後，體重是正常鼠的3倍。

(B) 鉀離子進入$\beta$細胞

(C) 胰臟$\beta$細胞去極化

(D) 昇糖激素促使血糖增加

Reading 3: Questions 42–44 form a group.

Biological invasion by alien species means that a species that has moved into a new habitat successfully establishes a new population and has a major impact on the local ecology. More and more studies have found that many alien organisms, after being introduced into a new region, do not immediately have a major effect on the local ecosystem; only after several years or even decades does a huge population of the alien species appear and impact the ecosystem, that is, there is a long time lag between introduction and the ecological impact. In addition, some alien organisms have a clear effect on the ecosystem only after being introduced several times. Studies have also found that if an alien organism is introduced repeatedly from different source regions, the probability of a massive population increase with a major impact on the ecosystem is even higher. In tropical forests of the Americas, leaf-cutter ants are famous for "farming" sugar-producing fungi in their nests. Leaf-cutter ants cut plant leaves into small pieces and carry them back to the nest; after chewing, the pieces become a source of nutrients for a special fungus, forming a "fungus farm", and the ants feed the newly grown hyphae to their larvae. The presence of leaf-cutter ants not only promotes the growth of new leaves in plants but also accelerates nutrient cycling. In recent years, scientists have found that bacteria also play a very important role in this "leaf-cutter ant–plant–fungus" system. Dr. Cameron Currie was the first to discover that a species of Streptomyces grows on the backs of leaf-cutter ants; this bacterium produces an antibiotic that inhibits the growth of other fungi. If the leaf-cutter ants abandon the "fungus farm", various weedy fungi will grow. In the most recent research, scientists have also found another symbiotic bacterium in the nests of American leaf-cutter ants, Klebsiella, which can help fix nitrogen from the air. The nitrogen fixed by Klebsiella growing in the "fungus farm" can be absorbed by the fungus and then used by the leaf-cutter ants. Based on this passage and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

36. Which of the following groups of organisms does not take part in the symbiotic relationships described in the passage?

(A) Bacteria

(B) Protists

(C) Arthropods

(D) Fungi

在美洲熱帶森林中，切葉蟻因為會在蟻巢中「豢養」能產生糖的真菌而聞名。切葉蟻將植物葉片切成小塊帶回巢穴中，經咀嚼後讓它成為一種特殊真菌的養分來源，形成一處「真菌農場」，而切葉蟻會將新生的菌絲餵養其幼蟲。切葉蟻的存在，不僅會促進植物新葉生長，也會加速養分循環。而在近幾年的研究中，科學家們發現細菌在這個「切葉蟻－植物－真菌」間也扮演了十分重要的角色。卡麥隆．庫瑞博士首先發現在切葉蟻的背上，生長著一種鏈黴菌，這種細菌會產生一種抗生素，抑制其他種真菌的生長。若切葉蟻將「真菌農場」棄之不顧，則會生長出各式不同的雜類真菌。在最近的研究中，科學家們又發現在美洲切葉蟻巢中，還有另一種共生細菌-克氏菌，此菌能幫助固定空氣中的氮。克氏菌生長在「真菌農場」內所固定下來的氮，可以為真菌所吸收，進而被切葉蟻所利用。依本文所述及相關知識，回答下列問題：

(B) 原生生物

(C) 節肢動物

(D) 真菌

In February 2012 a research team in Taiwan published in a scientific journal a result that astonished the world; the following is information about this research. "How is unstable short-term memory (STM) converted into long-term memory (LTM)?" has long been a life phenomenon about which people are very curious and interested. Although studies have indicated that the hippocampus of the human brain is related to LTM formation, the neural structures and cell signalling pathways in the brains of vertebrates are too complex, and it is very difficult to clarify which neurons in the vertebrate brain take part in the formation of LTM. However, researchers have found that the process of memory formation in Drosophila is similar to that in humans, and LTM can be formed through repeated learning combined with moderate rest. Furthermore, the neural network in the Drosophila brain is simpler than that of vertebrates, and because of factors such as its short life cycle, high fecundity and sequenced genome, many researchers use Drosophila for LTM-related experiments. Before the report of the Taiwanese team, scientists mostly believed that the part of the Drosophila brain responsible for learning and memory was the mushroom body, which has several thousand neurons.

RICIN is a toxin protein of the castor bean (a plant); it affects the synthesis of newly made proteins by destroying 28S rRNA. Since the formation of LTM is related to new protein synthesis, the Taiwanese research team used genetic engineering techniques to express RICIN in different neurons of the Drosophila brain, in order to clarify which neurons take part in the formation of LTM in Drosophila. Unexpectedly, they found that when RICIN was expressed in two neurons of the brain called DAL, the formation and storage of LTM were prevented, but expression in the mushroom body had no effect. This result shows that the DAL neurons, rather than the mushroom body, should be the site of LTM formation and storage. They also found that, after Drosophila learned with moderate rest, the two genes CaMKII and period were activated in DAL, so it was inferred that these two genes take part in the process of LTM formation and storage. The above experimental results show a possible mechanism of LTM formation and storage.

Based on this passage and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

39. Which of the following statements about the formation and storage of long-term memory are correct?

(A) Repeated learning combined with moderate rest helps the formation of long-term memory

(B) The Taiwanese research team found that the site of long-term memory formation and storage is not the mushroom body

(C) The formation and storage of long-term memory do not require the participation of newly synthesised proteins

(D) The Taiwanese research team found that long-term memory formation and storage are controlled by several thousand neurons in the brain

(E) According to the inference, CaMKII and period are related to the formation and storage of long-term memory

2012年2月臺灣研究團隊在科學期刊發表了震驚世界的科學研究成果，以下是有關於此研究的相關資訊。「不穩定的短期記憶（short-term memory, STM）如何轉化成長期記憶（long-term memory, LTM）？」一直是人們非常好奇且感興趣的生命現象。雖然有研究指出人類大腦的海馬迴與LTM形成有關，但脊椎動物腦部神經結構與細胞訊息傳遞路徑過於複雜，非常難釐清脊椎動物的腦部有哪些神經元參與LTM的形成過程。然而研究學者發現果蠅的記憶形成過程與人類相似，可經由重複學習搭配適度休息，得以達到LTM的形成。再者，果蠅腦部神經網絡較脊椎動物簡單，且由於生活史短、繁殖力強、基因體也被解碼等因素，許多學者利用果蠅進行LTM相關實驗。在臺灣團隊的報導前，科學家大都認為果蠅腦部負責學習及記憶的部位為具有數千個神經元的蕈狀體。

In February 2012 a research team in Taiwan published in a scientific journal a result that astonished the world; the following is information about this research. "How is unstable short-term memory (STM) converted into long-term memory (LTM)?" has long been a life phenomenon about which people are very curious and interested. Although studies have indicated that the hippocampus of the human brain is related to LTM formation, the neural structures and cell signalling pathways in the brains of vertebrates are too complex, and it is very difficult to clarify which neurons in the vertebrate brain take part in the formation of LTM. However, researchers have found that the process of memory formation in Drosophila is similar to that in humans, and LTM can be formed through repeated learning combined with moderate rest. Furthermore, the neural network in the Drosophila brain is simpler than that of vertebrates, and because of factors such as its short life cycle, high fecundity and sequenced genome, many researchers use Drosophila for LTM-related experiments. Before the report of the Taiwanese team, scientists mostly believed that the part of the Drosophila brain responsible for learning and memory was the mushroom body, which has several thousand neurons.

RICIN is a toxin protein of the castor bean (a plant); it affects the synthesis of newly made proteins by destroying 28S rRNA. Since the formation of LTM is related to new protein synthesis, the Taiwanese research team used genetic engineering techniques to express RICIN in different neurons of the Drosophila brain, in order to clarify which neurons take part in the formation of LTM in Drosophila. Unexpectedly, they found that when RICIN was expressed in two neurons of the brain called DAL, the formation and storage of LTM were prevented, but expression in the mushroom body had no effect. This result shows that the DAL neurons, rather than the mushroom body, should be the site of LTM formation and storage. They also found that, after Drosophila learned with moderate rest, the two genes CaMKII and period were activated in DAL, so it was inferred that these two genes take part in the process of LTM formation and storage. The above experimental results show a possible mechanism of LTM formation and storage.

(C) It activates the CaMKII and period genes of Drosophila neurons

(D) It is a good tool for investigating LTM in Drosophila

(E) When expressed only in the mushroom body, the formation and storage of long-term memory in Drosophila remain normal

Clinically there is a disease called sleep apnea syndrome. During sleep, patients repeatedly experience breathing pauses and upper airway obstruction many times a night; the blood oxygen concentration decreases with the breathing pauses while the carbon dioxide concentration increases, and the patients have abnormal cognitive and cardiovascular function. In animal experiments, intermittent hypoxia causes some neurons in the central nervous system to release excessive glutamate, causing excessive excitation of cognition- and sleep-related neurons, which secrete inflammation-related cytokines such as IL-1 and TNF$\alpha$; in addition, these neurons produce excessive ROS (an indicator product of oxidative stress), making the neurons prone to apoptosis. The experiments also found that sympathetic nerve activity of the animals was enhanced: the hypoxia signal is detected by peripheral chemoreceptors and transmitted to the medulla, and then to the hypothalamus, so that the nerve terminals projecting from the hypothalamus to the rostral medulla increase their release of antidiuretic hormone, with the result that the activity of the neurons descending from the rostral medulla to the sympathetic preganglionic neurons is enhanced, leading to increased vascular resistance and a faster heartbeat. Therefore, blocking the antidiuretic hormone receptors in the rostral medulla improves hypertension. Based on the above passage and the knowledge you have learned, answer the following questions:

42. Which of the following factors are closely related to the patient's raised blood pressure?

(A) Enhanced sympathetic nerve activity

(B) Increased blood oxygen concentration

(C) Contraction of the smooth muscle of arterioles

(D) Excessive oxidising substances produced by the sympathetic and parasympathetic nerves

(E) Increased excitation of neurons in the rostral medulla

(E) 延腦吻端的神經元興奮增強

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

Mycobacterium leprae is the causative bacterium of leprosy. It invades and survives in the phagosomes of macrophages and multiplies by obtaining energy through a special metabolism. In 2001, Cole S. et al. published the genome sequence of Mycobacterium leprae in the journal Nature and compared it with the genome sequence of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, giving a reasonable explanation for the distinctive metabolism and the special reductive evolution of Mycobacterium leprae. Mycobacterium leprae has about 3.3 million bases, containing 1600 functional genes, whereas Mycobacterium tuberculosis has 4.4 million bases, containing 4000 functional genes; many of the functional genes of Mycobacterium tuberculosis exist in Mycobacterium leprae as non-functional pseudogenes because their structure is incomplete. Later studies found that Mycobacterium leprae has lost many genes related to the metabolism of host lipids that are present in pathogenic bacteria of the genus Mycobacterium. It is inferred that Mycobacterium leprae may be able to grow and multiply in macrophages only through a metabolic pathway different from that of other mycobacteria.

Compared with its non-parasitic ancestor, Mycobacterium leprae has gradually lost more than half of its genes because they are no longer needed for survival, and the proportion lost is far higher than in any organism studied so far. However, this gene loss does not affect its pathogenicity; on the contrary, because the genome composition is simple, it helps scientists locate the important clusters of pathogenic genes and then develop new vaccines and diagnostic reagents for leprosy. According to this passage and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

36. Which of the following statements about the reductive evolution of Mycobacterium leprae are correct?

(A) It gradually loses some genes

(B) It leads to a smaller cell size

(C) It helps in finding clusters of pathogenic genes

(D) It leads to reduced pathogenicity

(E) It leads to a smaller genome
problems.problem_orig:
[多選題]

閱讀一

痲瘋分支桿菌（Mycobacterium leprae）是痲瘋病（leprosy）的病原菌，它會侵入並存活在巨噬細胞的吞噬小體，並經由特殊代謝獲得能量而進行繁殖。2001年，Cole S.等人於自然雜誌發表痲瘋分支桿菌的基因體序列，並與肺結核分支桿菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis）的基因體序列作比較，對痲瘋分支桿菌特有的代謝方式及特殊的縮減式演化（reductive evolution）提出合理的解釋。痲瘋分支桿菌約有330萬個鹼基，其中有1600個功能基因，而肺結核分支桿菌有440萬個鹼基，其中有4000個功能基因；肺結核分支桿菌中有許多的功能基因，在痲瘋分支桿菌因結構不完整而以無功能性的假基因方式存在。後來的研究發現，痲瘋分支桿菌失去許多分支桿菌屬致病性細菌代謝宿主脂類的相關基因。推測痲瘋分支桿菌可能是經由不同於其他分枝桿菌的代謝途徑，才得以在巨噬細胞中生長與繁殖。

相較於其非寄生性的始祖，痲瘋分支桿菌有一半以上的基因，因為不再是生存所需而逐漸丟失，且丟失比例遠高於目前所有研究過的生物。唯這種基因丟失並不影響其致病能力，反而因為基因組成簡單，有利於科學家定位重要致病基因群，進而發展痲瘋病的新疫苗及診斷試劑。依本文所述及相關知識，回答下列問題：

36. 下列關於痲瘋分支桿菌縮減式演化的敘述，哪些正確？

(A)逐漸失去部份基因

(B)導致體積變小

(C)有助於找出致病基因群

(D)導致致病力降低

(E)導致基因體縮小

Mycobacterium leprae has about 3.3 million bases, containing 1600 functional genes, whereas Mycobacterium tuberculosis has 4.4 million bases, containing 4000 functional genes; many of the functional genes of Mycobacterium tuberculosis exist in Mycobacterium leprae as non-functional pseudogenes because their structure is incomplete. Compared with its non-parasitic ancestor, Mycobacterium leprae has gradually lost more than half of its genes because they are no longer needed for survival, and the proportion lost is far higher than in any organism studied so far. Parkinson’s disease is a common neurodegenerative disease; about 1% of people over 65 years of age have it. Besides environmental factors, recent studies show that whether mitochondrial function is normal is closely related to the occurrence of this disease. Genetic studies of patients with familial Parkinson’s disease show that, among the many disease-causing genes of Parkinson’s disease, the product of the PINK1 gene is an enzyme located on the mitochondria that has phosphatase activity. Under normal conditions, hydrogen ions are unevenly distributed on the two sides of the inner mitochondrial membrane, forming a potential difference, which transports the PINK1 enzyme to the inner membrane, where it is rapidly degraded. But when the mitochondrial membrane potential is disrupted, the PINK1 enzyme stays on the outer mitochondrial membrane and accumulates by autophosphorylation, causing the Parkin protein in the cytoplasm to move to the mitochondria, which in turn causes some outer mitochondrial membrane proteins to be modified by ubiquitination, and finally induces the damaged mitochondria to be broken down through the autophagy pathway. Therefore, when the PINK1 or Parkin gene is mutated and loses its function, the cell may be unable to remove damaged mitochondria effectively, so that the cell loses its viability and goes towards death. The red imported fire ant found in Taiwan is mainly Solenopsis invicta, one of the 280 species of Solenopsis. It is native to South America, but its most direct source points to California in the United States. In the 1930s, the fire ant was found and drew attention in the southern coastal states of the United States. Investigation showed that the species first appeared in the state of Alabama, in connection with the docking of cargo ships. To prevent the fire ant from causing serious harm in Taiwan, in 2004 various parties strongly urged the establishment of a dedicated agency to take active measures to reduce its harm to human health, social disturbance, economic losses and ecological change.

The fire ant is an excellent predator; its prey includes the sugarcane pest white-spotted pseudo-butterfly moth and the rice pest brown rice stink bug, among others. But it also kills pollinating insects, such as bees and many other species. Controlling the fire ant is not easy. The physical method is to burn the ant nest or spray hot steam to destroy the ant mound, but this is a dangerous action; the chemical method is, for example, to mix poison into bait to kill them. In South America, the phorid fly (Pseudacteon tricupis) lays eggs on and parasitizes the head and thorax of the fire ant, and it is species-specific. The fly larva gradually gnaws away the head of the fire ant and uses the components of its exoskeleton as its puparium. Scientists have also found that 20% of fire ants carry the SINV-1 virus, which causes the ant colony to die slowly. According to this passage and related knowledge, answer the following questions:

(A) Its scientific name must be Solenopsis invicta

(B) Its occurrence in the United States is due to natural migration of its population

(C) It was introduced into Taiwan in order to control the damage caused by the brown rice stink bug

(D) Its advantage as a predator harms the local ecological balance

在臺灣發現的紅火蟻主要是Solenopsis invicta，它是Solenopsis中280個物種之一，原產於南美洲，但最直接的來源指向美國加州。1930年代，紅火蟻在美國的南方沿海各州被發現，並引人注意。經追查，此物種最先出現在阿拉巴馬州，與貨船的泊靠有關。為防止紅火蟻在臺灣造成嚴重危害，2004年各方力促成立專責機構，採取積極行動，以降低其對人體健康、社會擾動、經濟損失以及生態變遷等的危害。

紅火蟻是絕佳的掠食者，其獵物包括甘蔗的害蟲白斑擬蝶蛾，及水稻的害蟲稻褐蝽等。但是牠也殺害傳粉昆蟲，如蜜蜂等諸多物種。控制紅火蟻並不容易，物理方法是對蟻巢用火燒或噴熱蒸氣來消滅蟻塚，但卻是危險的行動；化學方法如用毒劑混入食餌中毒殺之。在南美洲，蚤蠅（Pseudacteon tricupis）會產卵並寄生在紅火蟻的頭胸部，且具有物種專一性。蚤蠅的幼蟲會逐步啃食紅火蟻的頭部，以其外骨骼的成份作為蛹殼。科學家也發現20%的紅火蟻帶有SINV-1病毒，造成蟻群慢慢死亡。依本文所述及相關知識，回答下列問題：

紅火蟻是絕佳的掠食者，其獵物包括甘蔗的害蟲白斑擬蝶蛾，及水稻的害蟲稻褐蝽等。但是牠也殺害傳粉昆蟲，如蜜蜂等諸多物種。控制紅火蟻並不容易，物理方法是對蟻巢用火燒或噴熱蒸氣來消滅蟻塚，但卻是危險的行動；化學方法如用毒劑混入食餌中毒殺之。在南美洲，蚤蠅（Pseudacteon tricupis）會產卵並寄生在紅火蟻的頭胸部，且具有物種專一性。蚤蠅的幼蟲會逐步啃食紅火蟻的頭部，以其外骨骼的成份作為蛹殼。科學家也發現20%的紅火蟻帶有SINV-1病毒，造成蟻群慢慢死亡。依本文所述及相關知識，回答下列問題：

Reading 1: Questions 36–38 form a group.

After the Industrial Revolution, human activities caused the concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere to increase, leading to global warming and causing many behavioural activities and physiological responses of organisms to occur earlier, such as the migration of organisms, the hatching and development of insects, and the sprouting and flowering of plants. It was formerly thought that these phenomena occur because individual organisms make behavioural, morphological or physiological adjustments in order to adapt to environmental change, which is called phenotypic plasticity. Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

Early scientists found that flowering in plants is controlled by a certain plant hormone, but it remained unclear what the hormone was, and this hypothetical hormone was called florigen. In the 20th century, scientists made breakthrough progress in the discovery of florigen. In the 1930s, scientists subjected tobacco, a short-day plant, to long-day (short-dark) and short-day (long-dark) treatments respectively, and then grafted the long-day-treated tobacco onto the short-day-treated tobacco; the result was that the long-day-treated tobacco flowered, suggesting that florigen can be transported through the vascular bundles to the meristem at the stem apex and induce it to differentiate into flower buds. By the end of the 20th century, scientists used the long-day plant Arabidopsis for molecular physiological experiments and found that when Arabidopsis is under long-day conditions, the transcription factor CO protein accumulates in the leaf veins and activates the promoter of the FT gene in mesophyll cells, so that it is transcribed into mRNA, which is translated in the companion cells of the leaf veins. The synthesized FT protein is transported into the sieve tube cells with the help of the FTIP1 protein on the endoplasmic reticulum, and is then carried through the phloem to the stem apex, where it combines with the FD protein of the stem apex to form the FT-FD complex. The FD gene is expressed in the stem apex, but its expression is not affected by day length or by the CO protein. The FT-FD complex is also a transcription factor; it activates the expression of downstream genes in the cells of the apical bud, such as AP1, and, together with the expression of SOC1 and other genes, starts the flowering program. Under long days, the expression level of SOC1 rises and activates the LFY gene in the apical bud meristem, and the activation of LFY starts the development of flower buds. If the SOC1 gene is mutated and not expressed, the plant does not flower even when FT protein is strongly expressed, which proves that SOC1 is also one of the important signals for plant flowering. Because FT can move over long distances through the phloem in the plant and serves as a flowering signal, scientists consider that FT may be the long-sought florigen. According to this passage and related knowledge, answer Questions 39–41:

(A)The CO protein, the transcription factor of the FT gene, must be present in most flowering plants

(B)FT in a long-day plant can induce a grafted seedling of a short-day plant to flower

(C)The CO protein in a long-day plant can induce expression of the FT gene in a grafted seedling of a short-day plant, causing the short-day plant to flower

(D)FD in a long-day plant can be transported to the stem apex of a short-day grafted seedling and combine with the FT protein

早期科學家發現植物開花是由某種植物激素控制，但卻一直不清楚該激素為何，而稱這種假想的激素為開花素（florigen）。20世紀科學家對開花素的發現有了突破性的進展。1930年代科學家對短日照植物的菸草分別進行長日照（短黑暗）與短日照（長黑暗）處理，再將長日照處理的菸草嫁接至短日照處理的菸草上，結果使長日照處理的菸草開花，暗示了開花素可藉由維管束運送至莖頂的分生組織，促使其分化為花芽。到了20世紀末，科學家又以長日照的阿拉伯芥為材料，進行分子生理實驗，發現當阿拉伯芥處於長日照條件下，轉錄因子CO蛋白會累積在葉脈並會活化葉肉細胞中的FT基因的啟動子（promoter），使其轉錄為mRNA，並在葉脈的伴細胞進行轉譯。合成後的FT蛋白藉由內質網上的FTIP1蛋白協助運送到篩管細胞內，再藉由韌皮部運輸至莖頂，與莖頂的FD蛋白結合形成FT-FD複合體。FD的基因表現在莖頂，但它的表現不會受到日照長短和CO蛋白的影響。FT-FD複合體也是轉錄因子，會活化在頂芽細胞內的下游基因如AP1的表現，並協同SOC1及其他基因的表現，啟動開花的程序。長日照下，SOC1的表現量會上升，並啟動頂芽分生組織的LFY基因，LFY活化則啟動花芽的發育。若SOC1基因發生突變不表現，即使FT蛋白大量表現也不開花，證明SOC1也是植物開花的重要訊號之一。因FT在植物體內可以藉由韌皮部進行長距離移動並擔任開花的訊息因子，故科學家認為FT可能就是尋找已久的開花素。依本文所述及相關知識，回答第39-41題：

39. 下列哪一條件支持FT蛋白可能為開花素？

(A)FT基因的轉錄因子CO蛋白必須存在於大多數的開花植物中

(B)長日照植物中的FT可以誘導短日照植物的嫁接苗開花

(C)長日照植物中的CO蛋白可以誘導短日照植物嫁接苗的FT基因表現，使短日照植物開花

(D)長日照植物中的FD可運送至短日照嫁接苗植物的莖頂，與FT蛋白結合

早期科學家發現植物開花是由某種植物激素控制，但卻一直不清楚該激素為何，而稱這種假想的激素為開花素（florigen）。20世紀科學家對開花素的發現有了突破性的進展。1930年代科學家對短日照植物的菸草分別進行長日照（短黑暗）與短日照（長黑暗）處理，再將長日照處理的菸草嫁接至短日照處理的菸草上，結果使長日照處理的菸草開花，暗示了開花素可藉由維管束運送至莖頂的分生組織，促使其分化為花芽。到了20世紀末，科學家又以長日照的阿拉伯芥為材料，進行分子生理實驗，發現當阿拉伯芥處於長日照條件下，轉錄因子CO蛋白會累積在葉脈並會活化葉肉細胞中的FT基因的啟動子（promoter），使其轉錄為mRNA，並在葉脈的伴細胞進行轉譯。合成後的FT蛋白藉由內質網上的FTIP1蛋白協助運送到篩管細胞內，再藉由韌皮部運輸至莖頂，與莖頂的FD蛋白結合形成FT-FD複合體。FD的基因表現在莖頂，但它的表現不會受到日照長短和CO蛋白的影響。FT-FD複合體也是轉錄因子，會活化在頂芽細胞內的下游基因如AP1的表現，並協同SOC1及其他基因的表現，啟動開花的程序。長日照下，SOC1的表現量會上升，並啟動頂芽分生組織的LFY基因，LFY活化則啟動花芽的發育。若SOC1基因發生突變不表現，即使FT蛋白大量表現也不開花，證明SOC1也是植物開花的重要訊號之一。因FT在植物體內可以藉由韌皮部進行長距離移動並擔任開花的訊息因子，故科學家認為FT可能就是尋找已久的開花素。依本文所述及相關知識，回答第39-41題：

(B)莖維管束內的韌皮部FD基因大量表現

(C)CO蛋白誘導葉肉細胞裡的FT基因表現

(D)FT-FD複合體運送至葉肉細胞以誘導下游基因表現

(E)SOC1活化頂芽分生組織的分化

Innate immunity is the front-line defence against viruses, and its response occurs within minutes to hours. The most important part of it is the cellular barrier, which includes immune cells such as macrophages and dendritic cells, as well as non-immune cells such as endothelial cells and epithelial cells. When a virus infects, these cells can use intracellular pattern recognition receptors (PAMPs) to detect the invading virus; for example, among the Toll-like receptors (TLRs), TLR7 mainly recognizes the single-stranded RNA of viruses, and the receptor RIG-1 recognizes single-stranded RNA carrying three phosphate groups at the 5’ end or short double-stranded RNA fragments of viruses. When PAMPs recognize viral components, they promote the production of type I interferon and inflammation-related cytokines and cause an inflammatory response, which attracts more immune cells to eliminate the virus. In addition, mature dendritic cells activated by detecting the virus can present the antigen to T lymphocytes to start a specific adaptive immune response, and when the same virus is encountered again in the future, an immune response can be produced rapidly through the memory of the immune cells.

Developing antiviral drugs or vaccines can suppress the spread of infectious diseases and free humans from the threat of viruses. Even so, some vaccines that use purified antigens still cannot produce a good immune response in the human body. Therefore, in the course of vaccine development, scientists found that the use of adjuvants can strengthen the immune response to a vaccine and promote the generation of immune memory. Aluminium salts were the earliest vaccine adjuvants used; they can help prolong the time that the antigen exists in the body and increase the chance of immune cells detecting the antigen; recently it has also been found that aluminium salts can activate the innate immune response through receptors such as the TLR family and enhance the ability of dendritic cells to present antigens. The adjuvant MPL, which is already on the market, can promote the signal transduction pathway downstream of TLR4 and enhance antibody production, and has been used in vaccines against hepatitis B or human papillomavirus. Therefore, vaccines designed with good use of knowledge about innate immunity will certainly be able to improve human welfare in the future. (A)The receptor RIG-1 is located inside the cell

(B)RIG-1 can recognize short single-stranded RNA fragments of the virus

(C)After recognizing the virus, type I interferon is produced

(D)After recognizing the virus, an inflammatory response is triggered

先天免疫是對抗病毒的最前線防護，反應的時間在幾分鐘到幾小時之內，其中最重要的是細胞性屏障，包括巨噬細胞和樹突細胞等免疫細胞，以及內皮細胞或上皮細胞等非免疫細胞。當病毒感染時，這些細胞可以利用胞內的模式辨認受體（PAMPs）偵測入侵的病毒，例如類鐸受體（TLRs）中的TLR7主要辨識病毒的單股RNA，受體RIG-1則辨識病毒5’端帶有三個磷酸根的單股RNA或短片段的雙股RNA。當PAMPs辨識病毒成分後，促進第一型干擾素和發炎相關細胞激素的產生，引起發炎反應，以吸引更多的免疫細胞來清除病毒。此外，藉由偵測到病毒而活化的成熟樹突細胞，可把抗原呈獻給T淋巴細胞，以啟動專一性的後天性免疫反應，當未來再遇到相同病毒時，可以透過免疫細胞的記憶性，快速產生免疫反應。

研發抗病毒藥物或疫苗能抑制傳染病的擴散，讓人類免於病毒的威脅。儘管如此，有些疫苗使用純化的抗原，在人體內仍無法產生很好的免疫反應。因此，在疫苗發展過程中，科學家們發現佐劑的使用可以加強疫苗的免疫反應，並促進免疫記憶性的產生。鋁鹽是最早使用的疫苗佐劑，可以協助延長抗原在體內存在時間，增加免疫細胞偵測到抗原的機會；近來更發現鋁鹽能經由TLR家族等受體，活化先天免疫的反應，增強樹突細胞呈獻抗原的能力。目前已上市的佐劑MPL，能促進TLR4下游的訊號傳導路徑，並增強抗體產生，已運用於對抗B型肝炎或人類乳頭狀瘤病毒的疫苗。因此，善加利用先天免疫的知識進行設計的疫苗，在未來一定可以增進人類福祉。依本文所述及相關知識，回答第42-44題：

42. RNA的流感病毒感染呼吸道黏膜後，推測受感染的上皮細胞經由RIG-1引起的先天性免疫反應之敘述，下列何者「不正確」？

(A)受體RIG-1位於細胞內

(B)RIG-1可以辨識病毒的短片段單股RNA

(C)辨識病毒後會產生第一型干擾素

(D)辨識病毒後會引起發炎反應

Reading 1: Questions 36–39 form a group.

As early as 70 years ago, scientists proposed that restricting calorie intake can extend lifespan. Past experiments with yeast, nematodes, fruit flies and mice have also generally supported this theory. However, extending human lifespan by dietary restriction is difficult to carry out in practice. Scientists have therefore worked on developing drugs that have the same effect as restricting human diet and calories. Among them, resveratrol is one of the widely studied subjects.

Resveratrol can activate the deacetylase SIRT1. Activated SIRT1, in the presence of $\mathrm{NAD^+}$, acts on the transcription factor PGC-1α, causing it to turn on a series of genes related to energy metabolism, thereby strengthening mitochondrial function and combating metabolic diseases. However, the mechanism by which resveratrol activates SIRT1 remains to be clarified. Recent experimental results indicate that resveratrol can inhibit phosphodiesterase, leading to an increase in the cAMP concentration in the cytoplasm, which in turn raises the concentration of free $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ in the cytoplasm and the activity of its downstream phosphorylating enzyme CamKKβ. CamKKβ acts on the enzyme AMPK and enhances its enzymatic activity. When AMPK is activated, it can on the one hand increase the concentration of $\mathrm{NAD^+}$ in the cytoplasm, and on the other hand phosphorylate PGC-1α. SIRT1 can recognize phosphorylated PGC-1α and activate its function. Based on the passage above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 36–39:

36. For which of the following research subjects is there a lack of direct experimental evidence that restricting dietary calories can extend lifespan?

(A) Yeast

(B) Nematodes

(C) Mice

(D) Humans
problems.problem_orig:
[單選題]

閱讀一

早在70年前，科學家就提出限制熱量攝取可以延長壽命的看法。過去以酵母菌、線蟲、果蠅與老鼠做實驗的結果，也普遍支持此理論。然而要以限制飲食的方式來延長人類的壽命，在執行上有其困難度。因此，科學家致力於開發與限制人體飲食及熱量具有相同效果的藥物。其中，白藜蘆醇是廣泛受重視的研究對象之一。

白藜蘆醇具有活化SIRT1去乙醯化酵素的功能。活化後的SIRT1在$\mathrm{NAD^+}$存在的條件下，會作用在PGC-1α這個轉錄因子上，使其開啟一系列與能量代謝有關的基因，進而強化粒線體功能並對抗代謝疾病。然而白藜蘆醇活化SIRT1的機制仍待進一步釐清。最近的實驗結果指出，白藜蘆醇可以抑制磷酸二酯酵素（phosphodiesterase），導致細胞質中的cAMP濃度增加，進而造成細胞質中游離的$\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$濃度及其下游的磷酸化酵素CamKKβ活性上升。CamKKβ會作用在AMPK酵素上，增強其酵素活性。當AMPK被活化後，一方面可增加細胞質中$\mathrm{NAD^+}$的濃度，另一方面會對PGC-1α進行磷酸化修飾。SIRT1能辨識被磷酸化的PGC-1α，並活化其功能。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第36-39題：

36. 下列研究對象何者缺乏直接實驗證據支持，限制飲食熱量可延長其壽命？

(A) 酵母菌

(B) 線蟲

(C) 老鼠

(D) 人類

38. Which of the following molecules has phosphatase activity?

Reading 2: Questions 40–43 form a group.

"AquAdvantage salmon" is a product of a US biotechnology company, derived from the wild Atlantic salmon (Salmon salar). The Atlantic salmon can reach a maximum body length of 150 cm and a body weight of 46.8 kgw, with a maximum lifespan of 13 years. The Pacific (Chinook) salmon (Oncorhynchus tshawytscha), a species closely related to the Atlantic salmon, has a maximum body length of 150 cm, a body weight of 61.4 kgw and a maximum lifespan of 9 years. Both of these salmon are members of the family Salmonidae in the subclass Actinopterygii.

The genome of the AquAdvantage salmon is the genome of the Atlantic salmon with an added segment of foreign DNA. This foreign DNA is composed of the promoter of the antifreeze protein gene of a deep-sea fish and the complementary DNA (cDNA) of the growth hormone gene of the Pacific salmon. The purpose of making this chimera was to modify the genome of the Atlantic salmon so that it grows faster, shortening the rearing time from 3 years to 16–18 months. In addition, studies show that this fish is more cold-tolerant than wild populations and has a higher flesh-gain rate. To gain the same body weight, farmed AquAdvantage salmon can save 10% of feed compared with wild Atlantic salmon. In 1996, an aquaculture company applied to the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to farm this fish in bays and market it. It was only after fourteen years that the FDA ruled that: (1) this fish should not cause any significant effect on the environment; (2) using this fish as food is as safe as using conventional Atlantic salmon. The FDA therefore considered that food made from AquAdvantage salmon is as safe as food from other Atlantic salmon. Environmentalists held a different opinion and argued that further careful assessment should be made before commercial farming. Based on the passage above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 40–43:

40. At which of the following taxonomic levels can a common ancestor of the Atlantic salmon and the Pacific salmon be found?

(A) Order

(B) Genus

(C) Species

(D) Subspecies

“水優鮭”是某一美國生技公司的產品，源自野生的大西洋鮭（Salmon salar）。大西洋鮭最大體長可達150 cm，體重46.8 kgw，最長壽命為13年。太平洋鮭（Oncorhynchus tshawytscha），是大西洋鮭的近似種，最大體長150 cm，體重61.4 kgw，最長壽命為9年。以上兩種鮭魚均為條鰭亞綱鮭科的成員。

水優鮭的基因體，是在大西洋鮭的基因體中加入一段外源DNA片段。此外源DNA是由某一深海魚之抗凍蛋白基因的啟動子（promoter），及太平洋鮭之生長激素基因的互補DNA（cDNA）所組合而成。製作此嵌合體之目的是為改造大西洋鮭的基因體，使其成長速率加快，養殖時間由3年縮短到16-18個月。此外，研究顯示此魚比野生族群耐寒，且具較高的增肉率。若要增加相同的體重，養殖水優鮭相較於野生大西洋鮭，可省10%的餌料。1996年，有一個水產公司向美國的藥物食品管理局（FDA）申請，欲以海灣養殖此魚並推廣上市。本申請案歷經十四年後，FDA才裁定：(1)此魚應不會對環境引起任何顯著影響；(2)以此魚做為食物的安全性與傳統大西洋鮭一樣安全。因此FDA認為：水優鮭所製作的食品與其他大西洋鮭的食品一樣安全。環保人士對此則持不同意見，認為在進行商業養殖前應再審慎評估。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第40-43題：

(A) 目

(B) 屬

(C) 物種

(D) 亞種

The proteasome system is located in the cytoplasm and the nucleus and is responsible for degrading short-lived proteins; the enzymatically active region that degrades proteins is confined to the inside of the structure. The substrate must pass through the openings at the two ends of the proteasome in order to enter the interior and be hydrolysed. Because of the limited size of the openings at the two ends of the proteasome, only polypeptide chains whose three-dimensional structure has first been destroyed can be substrates of the proteasome. Protein complexes, limited by their size, cannot enter the interior of the proteasome, and their degradation is carried out by the lysosome system.

The lysosome is an organelle surrounded by a biological membrane. It contains a large amount of hydrolytic enzymes that can degrade the various substrates that enter it; these substrates include protein monomers, protein complexes and even whole organelles. It is currently known that protein complexes can enter the lysosome by two different transport routes: one is through invagination of the lysosomal membrane, which brings substrates attached to the lysosomal surface into the lysosome; the other mechanism is autophagy in the cytoplasm, in which protein complexes or organelles are enclosed into double-membrane autophagosomes, and the contents are degraded after the lysosome fuses with the autophagosome. (D) Release outside the cell by exocytosis

溶體是由生物膜圍繞而成的胞器，在溶體內含有大量的水解酵素，可分解進入溶體的各種受質，這些受質包含蛋白質單體、蛋白質複合體乃至於整個胞器。目前已知蛋白質複合體可經由兩種不同的運送途徑進入溶體，一是透過溶體膜內陷，將附著在溶體表面的受質帶入溶體內；另外一個機制則是在細胞質內進行自噬作用，將蛋白質複合體或胞器包裹成雙層膜的細胞自噬體，溶體與自噬體融合後再將內含物分解。依據上文內容和習得的知識，回答第44-46題：

Gene mutations can be classified by cause into spontaneous (congenital, inherited) and induced (influenced by the acquired environment). It is known that the occurrence of cancer is related to abnormal expression resulting from certain gene mutations, or to abnormal activity of the proteins subsequently translated as a result of gene mutations. Therefore, massive expression of oncogenes or increased activity of their proteins, or reduced expression of tumor suppressor genes or decreased activity of their proteins, can all trigger the transformation of normal cells into cancer cells. The regulation of gene expression is closely related to the activity of transcription factors, the stability of mRNA, and so on. Some of the abnormal expression or mutations of the oncogenes or tumor suppressor genes mentioned above are caused by the intercalation of certain foreign chemical carcinogens into the genomic DNA, the insertion of viral DNA, or environmental factors (such as stimulation by growth factors, inflammatory factors or pathogen infection), which trigger sustained rapid cell division, increasing the probability of replication errors and decreasing the probability that mutated genes are correctly repaired, and thereby accumulating the number of mutated genes. Based on the passage above and the knowledge you have learned, answer Questions 36–38:

(A) Gene mutations occur only in oncogenes

(B) Transcription may cause increased expression of oncogenes

(C) Transcription may cause decreased expression of tumor suppressor genes

(D) Mutations of oncogenes or tumor suppressor genes may cause cancer

(E) The formation of cancer is related only to gene mutations

In recent years, abnormal flooding stress caused by environmental change has seriously affected the production of food crops worldwide. Flooding causes plant roots to be deprived of oxygen, to generate too little energy, and to produce toxic alcohol, which leads to the death of the plants. However, among all cereal crops, rice is the only important food crop that can tolerate flooding. Flooding can increase the synthesis of plant hormones in rice: on the one hand, they promote cell division and elongation, so that the nodes of the stem elongate upward and the plant rises above the water surface for gas exchange; on the other hand, they promote the partial senescence and death of root cortex cells, which further specialize into aerenchyma with large intercellular spaces, favouring the storage of oxygen so that the roots remain active. After many years of research, scholars in Taiwan have further uncovered the molecular regulatory mechanism of flooding tolerance in rice. The research team found that when rice seeds are flooded and deprived of oxygen, the massive expression of genes is induced for two protein kinases (CIPK15 and SnRK1A), the transcription factor MYBS1, and α-amylase, which can convert starch into sugar. Previous studies had found that MYBS1 can bind to the promoter sequence of the α-amylase gene and increase its expression. When plant cells lack sugar, SnRK1A is promoted to activate the activity of MYBS1. Further analysis found that when the rice CIPK15 gene is mutated, the SnRK1A protein cannot accumulate, and it was also observed that CIPK15 mutant seeds cannot germinate and die when flooded and deprived of sugar at the same time. From these research results it is learned that the flooding-tolerance mechanism in plants works through the sugar-deprivation signaling pathway, promoting the breakdown of carbohydrates so that seeds have enough energy to germinate under water. The key findings of this paper can help breed various flooding-tolerant crops and reduce flood-related agricultural losses. (A) Gibberellin and abscisic acid

(B) Gibberellin and ethylene

(C) Auxin and abscisic acid

(D) Cytokinin and ethylene

In recent years, abnormal flooding stress caused by environmental change has seriously affected the production of food crops worldwide. Flooding causes plant roots to be deprived of oxygen, to generate too little energy, and to produce toxic alcohol, which leads to the death of the plants. However, among all cereal crops, rice is the only important food crop that can tolerate flooding. Flooding can increase the synthesis of plant hormones in rice: on the one hand, they promote cell division and elongation, so that the nodes of the stem elongate upward and the plant rises above the water surface for gas exchange; on the other hand, they promote the partial senescence and death of root cortex cells, which further specialize into aerenchyma with large intercellular spaces, favouring the storage of oxygen so that the roots remain active. After many years of research, scholars in Taiwan have further uncovered the molecular regulatory mechanism of flooding tolerance in rice. The research team found that when rice seeds are flooded and deprived of oxygen, the massive expression of genes is induced for two protein kinases (CIPK15 and SnRK1A), the transcription factor MYBS1, and α-amylase, which can convert starch into sugar. Previous studies had found that MYBS1 can bind to the promoter sequence of the α-amylase gene and increase its expression. When plant cells lack sugar, SnRK1A is promoted to activate the activity of MYBS1. Further analysis found that when the rice CIPK15 gene is mutated, the SnRK1A protein cannot accumulate, and it was also observed that CIPK15 mutant seeds cannot germinate and die when flooded and deprived of sugar at the same time. From these research results it is learned that the flooding-tolerance mechanism in plants works through the sugar-deprivation signaling pathway, promoting the breakdown of carbohydrates so that seeds have enough energy to germinate under water. The key findings of this paper can help breed various flooding-tolerant crops and reduce flood-related agricultural losses. (C) Citric acid cycle → CIPK15 → SnRK1A → MYBS1 → α-amylase

(D) MYBS1 → α-amylase → citric acid cycle → CIPK15 → SnRK1A

Reading 3: Questions 42–44 form a group.

Autism spectrum disorder (ASD, referred to simply as autism) is a neurodevelopmental disorder. Besides often being accompanied by abnormalities in abilities and behaviours such as social interaction, communication and stereotyped repetitive movements, it also involves gastrointestinal symptoms. In recent years researchers have found that the "gut microbiota" appears to be clearly correlated with the course of ASD. The gut microbiota is the total composition of the intestinal bacteria, and plays important roles in maintaining intestinal health, digesting nutrients and stimulating immune development.

In 2013 scientists confirmed that several behavioural abnormalities associated with ASD can be improved by changing the gut microbiota. The following is a summary of the main points of this study. To observe the influence of the gut microbiota on the regulation of abnormal ASD behaviours, the animal model of ASD used in the study was created by maternal immune activation (MIA): a viral mimic was injected into pregnant mother mice to over-stimulate their immune systems, and their offspring were found to show abnormal behaviours similar to ASD. As in human ASD patients, these MIA offspring also have gastrointestinal symptoms, such as an abnormal increase in the permeability of the small intestine and over-activation of the inflammatory marker IL-6 in the large intestine. Compared with normal mice, in the gut microbiota of MIA offspring the relative numbers of bacteria belonging to the classes Clostridia and Bacteroidia were not significantly different, but the species composition was clearly changed. When the research team treated MIA offspring with Bacteroides fragilis, a human gut commensal bacterium, besides relieving the gastrointestinal symptoms and changing the gut microbiota, it also reduced stereotyped repetitive behaviours and increased sensitivity to communication sounds, but still could not improve the deficits in social behaviour and social preference behaviour. In addition, in the serum of MIA offspring, the metabolite 4EPS (4-ethylphenylsulphate) produced by gut bacteria was increased by about 46-fold. When 4EPS was given to normal mice, it caused abnormal behaviours similar to those of MIA offspring. The above experimental results show that the gut microbiota may play an important role in the generation of abnormal ASD behaviours. Based on this passage and related knowledge, answer Questions 42–44:

42. Which of the following statements about MIA is correct?

(A) It is a viral mimic that can be used to stimulate the immune response of mice

(B) It is an inflammatory marker that can produce a gut microbiota similar to that of ASD

(C) Through MIA it can be known that the formation of ASD may be related to immune responses

(D) The 4EPS in the serum is produced by the cells of the MIA offspring

閱讀三

自閉症類疾患（Autism Spectrum Disorder，ASD，簡稱自閉症）屬於神經系統發育異常疾病，除常伴隨著如社交、溝通及刻板重複動作等能力與行為異常外，亦有胃腸相關的症狀。近年研究者發現「腸道菌相」似乎與ASD患病歷程呈現明顯相關性。腸道菌相即為腸道細菌總組成，在維持腸道健康、消化營養及刺激免疫發展等扮演重要功能。

2013年科學家證實數個與ASD相關的行為異常，可因改變腸道菌相而有所改善，以下是此研究的重點摘述。本研究為觀測腸道菌相對ASD異常行為調控的影響力，而研究的ASD動物模式乃利用母體免疫系統過度活化（MIA; maternal immune activation）方式，將病毒類似物注射到懷孕母鼠中，過度刺激其免疫系統，發現其子代會有類似ASD的異常行為。相同於人類ASD患者，這群MIA子代同樣也有胃腸症狀，如小腸通透性的異常增加及大腸中發炎指標物IL-6的過度活化。相較於正常小鼠，MIA子代腸道菌相中，歸屬於梭菌綱（Clostridia）及類桿菌綱（Bacteroidia）的細菌相對數量沒有明顯差異，但菌種種類已明顯改變。當研究團隊利用人類腸道共生菌的鬆脆類桿菌（Bacteroides fragilis）處理MIA子代，除可緩和胃腸症狀及改變腸道菌相外，亦可減低刻板重複行為，並提高對溝通聲音的敏感度，但仍無法改善社交行為和社交偏好行為的缺失。此外MIA子代的血清中，由腸道菌所產生之代謝物4EPS（4-ethylphenylsulphate）可增加約46倍。當正常小鼠給予4EPS時，即會引起類似MIA子代的異常行為。以上實驗結果顯示了腸道菌相可能在ASD異常行為的產生扮演重要角色。依本文所述及相關知識，回答42-44題：

42. 下列有關MIA的敘述，何者正確？

(A) 是一種病毒類似物，可用來刺激小鼠免疫反應

(B) 是一種發炎指標物，可產生與ASD相似的腸道菌相

(C) 透過MIA可知，ASD形成與免疫反應可能具有相關性

(D) 血清中4EPS是MIA子代的細胞所產生

To observe the influence of the gut microbiota on the regulation of abnormal ASD behaviours, the animal model of ASD used in the study was created by maternal immune activation (MIA): a viral mimic was injected into pregnant mother mice to over-stimulate their immune systems, and their offspring were found to show abnormal behaviours similar to ASD. As in human ASD patients, these MIA offspring also have gastrointestinal symptoms, such as an abnormal increase in the permeability of the small intestine and over-activation of the inflammatory marker IL-6 in the large intestine. Compared with normal mice, in the gut microbiota of MIA offspring the relative numbers of bacteria belonging to the classes Clostridia and Bacteroidia were not significantly different, but the species composition was clearly changed. When the research team treated MIA offspring with Bacteroides fragilis, a human gut commensal bacterium, besides relieving the gastrointestinal symptoms and changing the gut microbiota, it also reduced stereotyped repetitive behaviours and increased sensitivity to communication sounds, but still could not improve the deficits in social behaviour and social preference behaviour. In addition, in the serum of MIA offspring, the metabolite 4EPS (4-ethylphenylsulphate) produced by gut bacteria was increased by about 46-fold. When 4EPS was given to normal mice, it caused abnormal behaviours similar to those of MIA offspring. The above experimental results show that the gut microbiota may play an important role in the generation of abnormal ASD behaviours. 自閉症類疾患（Autism Spectrum Disorder，ASD，簡稱自閉症）屬於神經系統發育異常疾病，除常伴隨著如社交、溝通及刻板重複動作等能力與行為異常外，亦有胃腸相關的症狀。近年研究者發現「腸道菌相」似乎與ASD患病歷程呈現明顯相關性。腸道菌相即為腸道細菌總組成，在維持腸道健康、消化營養及刺激免疫發展等扮演重要功能。

2013年科學家證實數個與ASD相關的行為異常，可因改變腸道菌相而有所改善，以下是此研究的重點摘述。本研究為觀測腸道菌相對ASD異常行為調控的影響力，而研究的ASD動物模式乃利用母體免疫系統過度活化（MIA; maternal immune activation）方式，將病毒類似物注射到懷孕母鼠中，過度刺激其免疫系統，發現其子代會有類似ASD的異常行為。相同於人類ASD患者，這群MIA子代同樣也有胃腸症狀，如小腸通透性的異常增加及大腸中發炎指標物IL-6的過度活化。相較於正常小鼠，MIA子代腸道菌相中，歸屬於梭菌綱（Clostridia）及類桿菌綱（Bacteroidia）的細菌相對數量沒有明顯差異，但菌種種類已明顯改變。當研究團隊利用人類腸道共生菌的鬆脆類桿菌（Bacteroides fragilis）處理MIA子代，除可緩和胃腸症狀及改變腸道菌相外，亦可減低刻板重複行為，並提高對溝通聲音的敏感度，但仍無法改善社交行為和社交偏好行為的缺失。此外MIA子代的血清中，由腸道菌所產生之代謝物4EPS（4-ethylphenylsulphate）可增加約46倍。當正常小鼠給予4EPS時，即會引起類似MIA子代的異常行為。以上實驗結果顯示了腸道菌相可能在ASD異常行為的產生扮演重要角色。依本文所述及相關知識，回答42-44題：

Most voles, such as the meadow vole, have a polygynandrous mating system (multiple mates for both sexes); the prairie vole, however, is monogamous, and a female mates with only one male. Scientists found that oxytocin receptors in the brain of the prairie vole are clearly more abundant than in other vole species. If the interaction between oxytocin and its receptor in a female prairie vole is weakened with a drug, the female loses her monogamous (one-male) behavior. On the other hand, the brain of the male prairie vole also has clearly more receptors for arginine vasopressin (AVP) than polygynous male voles. If the interaction between AVP and its receptor is blocked, the male also becomes "unfaithful". Scientists cloned the AVP receptor gene of the prairie vole and transferred it into the brain of experimental mice, which are polygynous, and found that these mice gave up their polygynous behavior. Reading 2: Questions 39–41 form a group.

The lung has long been regarded as an important respiratory organ, but in fact the complexity of lung function far exceeds our present understanding. Recent studies indicate that the lung also plays an important role in platelet production. Megakaryocytes are the precursor cells of platelets; when parts of the edge of the plasma membrane of a mature megakaryocyte rupture and shed, the shed portions containing plasma membrane form platelets. Using biotechnology, researchers produced PF4-mTmG mice from mTmG mice. Unlike mTmG mice, PF4-mTmG mice produce megakaryocytes carrying green fluorescent protein (GFP) (GFP-megakaryocytes), and 2-photon intravital microscopy (2PIVM) was then used to observe GFP-megakaryocytes in tissues and the GFP-platelets produced when they rupture. The results showed that, besides large numbers of megakaryocytes in the lung, large numbers of platelets are produced and released there, with an estimated output of about 50% of all platelets of the mouse. In organ transplantation experiments the researchers then found that if the lung of a PF4-mTmG mouse is transplanted into an mTmG mouse, the transplanted PF4-mTmG lung loses the ability to produce GFP-platelets; however, if the lung of an mTmG mouse is transplanted into a PF4-mTmG mouse, large numbers of GFP-megakaryocytes and GFP-platelets are found in the transplanted mTmG lung. In addition, later studies further showed that the megakaryocytes appearing in the lung actually originate from the bone marrow, and then gather in the lung through blood circulation and produce platelets there. Answer Questions 39–41 based on this passage and related knowledge.

39. Which of the following statements about 2PIVM is correct?

(B) It is a technique that can track GFP-megakaryocytes

(C) It is a technique for producing GFP-megakaryocytes

(D) It is a technique that can promote platelet production by megakaryocytes

Reading 3: Questions 42–43 form a group.

Viola hondoensis is a perennial herb that grows under temperate deciduous forest. The plant produces new leaves mainly in two seasons: leaves that sprout in April (called summer leaves) drop in September; leaves that sprout in September (called winter leaves) drop in May of the following year. Researchers wanted to understand why the winter leaves of Viola hondoensis still drop in the following spring, when the climate has become suitable for growth. They proposed four hypotheses: Hypothesis (1): it is affected by environmental factors that differ between seasons (such as temperature and changes in day length); Hypothesis (2): the leaves of the forest canopy grow out and cause a shading effect; Hypothesis (3): the newly grown summer leaves shade the winter leaves; Hypothesis (4): the newly grown summer leaves compete with the winter leaves for nutrients.

To test these hypotheses, the researchers carried out three manipulation experiments that changed the environment of the winter leaves of Viola hondoensis. The experimental procedures (left column of the table below) and results (right column) are as follows:

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|}\hline \text{Experiment 1: In April, 10 artificially raised Viola hondoensis plants were transplanted and grown in an open field.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in April.}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{Experiment 2: Under the deciduous forest, 10 Viola hondoensis plants were selected and their summer leaves and winter leaves were arranged so as not to overlap.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in August.}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{Experiment 3: Under the deciduous forest, 10 Viola hondoensis plants were selected and their nutrient-consuming organs were removed.} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1. The winter leaves of the control plants dropped in May.}\\ \text{2. The winter leaves of the experimental plants dropped in July.}\end{array} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

Answer Questions 42–43 based on this passage.

(A) The experimental group of Experiment 1 makes the summer leaves not shaded by the winter leaves

(B) The experimental group of Experiment 2 makes the winter leaves not shaded by the summer leaves

(C) The control group of Experiment 2 consists of 10 plants selected under the deciduous forest whose summer leaves are removed

(D) The control group of Experiment 3 consists of 10 plants selected under the deciduous forest that are given fertilizer

日本菫菜（Viola hondoensis）是一種多年生的草本植物，生長在溫帶落葉林下，此植株主要在兩個季節萌發新葉︰四月萌發的葉子（稱為夏葉）到九月會掉落；九月萌發的葉子（稱為冬葉）則到隔年五月時會掉落。學者想要瞭解為什麼在氣候變得適合生長時，日本菫菜冬葉仍會在隔年春天時掉落？他們提出四個假設：假設(1)受到不同季節的環境因子（如氣溫、日照長短變化）之影響；假設(2)樹林冠層的葉子長出，造成遮光效應；假設(3)新長出的夏葉遮蔽了冬葉；假設(4)新長出的夏葉和冬葉競爭養分。

為了檢驗這些假設，學者進行三項改變日本菫菜冬葉環境的操縱實驗，實驗內容（下表左列）和結果（下表右列）如下：

$$\begin{array}{|l|l|}\hline \text{實驗一、在四月時，將10株人工培育的日本菫菜，移植到空曠地栽種。} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1.對照組植株的冬葉在五月時掉落。}\\ \text{2.實驗組植株的冬葉在四月掉落。}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{實驗二、在落葉林下選擇10株日本菫菜，將其夏葉與冬葉的葉片錯開。} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1.對照組植株的冬葉在五月時掉落。}\\ \text{2.實驗組植株的冬葉在八月掉落。}\end{array} \\ \hline \text{實驗三、在落葉林下選擇10株日本菫菜，移除其消耗養分的器官。} & \begin{array}{l}\text{1.對照組植株的冬葉在五月時掉落。}\\ \text{2.實驗組植株的冬葉在七月掉落。}\end{array} \\ \hline \end{array}$$

根據本文回答第42-43題。

(B) 實驗二的實驗組是使冬葉不會被夏葉遮蔽

(C) 實驗二的對照組為選擇10株落葉林下的植株，移除其夏葉

(D) 實驗三的對照組為選擇10株落葉林下的植株，給予施肥
